# Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Americas Resident Shows

Cirque du Soleil

[Las Vegas, NV](https://jooble.org/jobs/Las-Vegas%2C-NV)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8999456610917202514?p=1&pos=0&rgn=29341&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2460911458977896180&crId=US_0US_0)

Las Vegas, NVLas Vegas Office – Sales, Marketing and Communications /Permanent/Full-Time /Hybrid\*\*\*Le poste étant situé aux États-Unis, la description de poste est disponible uniquement en anglais.\*\*\*\*\*\*As this position in based in the United States, the job description is available in English only.\*\*\*\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_Senior Digital Marketing Manager – Americas Resident ShowsSales, Marketing and CommunicationsThe Senior Digital Marketing Manager, Americas Resident Shows, reporting to the Director of Marketing & Sales, will lead the digital media function for Cirque du Soleil's resident show productions across the Americas, with primary responsibility for Las Vegas, Orlando, and Hawai'i. This role will set portfolio-wide strategy and drive awareness, ticket sales, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency across paid search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, and emerging digital channels.Based in Las Vegas, the Senior Digital Marketing Manager will oversee the Digital Marketing Managers responsible for assigned show portfolios. This position will establish priorities and standards, manage performance and budgets, coach the team, strengthen measurement and optimization practices, and ensure each production receives focused, commercially driven digital support.The ideal candidate is a strategic and analytical digital leader with deep performance marketing expertise, strong people-management skills, and a record of translating data into action. This person can move confidently between portfolio strategy and campaign detail, influence senior stakeholders, and lead teams and partners in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.The Senior Digital Marketing Manager will:Define and lead the digital media strategy for the Americas Resident Shows portfolio, aligning investment and channel plans with show priorities, audience needs, and revenue goals.Lead, coach, and develop Digital Marketing Managers, setting clear expectations, assigning show portfolios, managing workload, and ensuring consistent performance across markets.Own portfolio-wide digital media planning, multi-million-dollar budgets, forecasting, pacing, and allocation recommendations based on demand, opportunity, and return on ad spend.Establish paid search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, and emerging-channel standards while ensuring strategies are tailored to each production and market.Review campaign structure, bidding, targeting, audience strategy, creative rotation, and optimization decisions, stepping into campaign detail when needed to improve results.Build a disciplined testing roadmap across creative, messaging, offers, landing pages, audience segmentation, bidding, and channel mix, and scale successful learnings across the portfolio.Analyze campaign, website, ticketing, and sales performance to identify trends, diagnose gaps, and recommend actions that improve revenue, conversion, and marketing efficiency.Strengthen measurement and reporting practices across platforms, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, pixels, attribution, and conversion tracking in partnership with Analytics and Technology.Partner with show marketing, CRM, Social Media, Communications, Creative, Revenue Management, Ticketing, Paid Digital Agencies and Sales teams to deliver integrated, audience-led strategies.Lead relationships with media agencies, platform partners, and vendors, ensuring strong execution, transparent reporting, accountability, and access to relevant opportunities and best practices.Develop annual digital plans, performance forecasts, executive-ready presentations, business cases, and clear recommendations for senior leadership and partner organizations.Communicate performance, risks, opportunities, insights, and next steps consistently to show teams, leadership, agencies, and key property or market partners.Evaluate emerging platforms, privacy changes, automation, AI solutions, and industry developments, translating relevant innovations into practical business opportunities.Create scalable processes, documentation, and operating rhythms that improve campaign governance, knowledge sharing, quality control, and cross-market collaboration, and lead special projects as assigned.The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications:Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.At least 8 years of progressive digital or performance marketing experience, including at least 3 years leading people, agencies, or a multi-brand digital media function.Demonstrated expertise in paid search, including Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, and paid social across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.Experience managing multi-million-dollar digital media budgets and making investment decisions based on ticket sales, revenue, conversion, and return on ad spend.Strong understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, pixels, attribution, audience segmentation, conversion optimization, A/B testing, and performance reporting.Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate complex data into clear strategies, priorities, and executive recommendations.Excellent leadership, presentation, stakeholder-management, project-management, and communication skills, with experience influencing agencies, partners, and cross-functional teams.Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to manage multiple shows, markets, and deadlines under pressure.Must reside in, or able to relocate without assistance to, Las Vegas, Nevada, and be available to travel regularly to supported markets, including Orlando and Hawai'i.Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of Form I-9 upon hire and submission of acceptable documentation verifying identity and work authorization.As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. We realize that one size fits none and invite you to come create your own specialized experience with us to see exactly what we’re talking about, firsthand. Our emotion-provoking shows are just the tip of the iceberg: laced throughout our organization, you will find creative minds who are empowered to use their voices and be themselves, their truest selves. Diversity to us means various perspectives, fresh ideas and continuous improvement of the way we do things. We won’t pretend like we have every answer, that’s why we need you! The employees here are the center of what we do, the voices behind the final product and amazing performances on stage. When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:Teamwork – we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;Respect – when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;Integrity – whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;Authenticity – we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;Being heard – you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, creed, color, age, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, national origin or ancestry.#li-promoteWe may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Company DescriptionProSidian is a Management and Operations Consulting Services Firm focusing on providing value to clients through tailored solutions based on industry leading practices. ProSidian services focus on the broad spectrum of Risk Management, Compliance, Business Process, IT Effectiveness, Energy & Sustainability, and Talent Management. We help forward thinking clients solve problems and improve operations. Launched by former Big 4 Management Consultants; our multidisciplinary teams bring together the talents of nearly 190 professionals globally to complete a wide variety of engagements for Private Companies, Fortune 1,000 Enterprises, and Government Agencies of all sizes. Our Services are deployed across the enterprise, target drivers of economic profit (growth, margin and efficiency), and are aligned at the intersections of assets, processes, policies and people delivering value. ProSidian clients represent a broad spectrum of industries to include but are not limited to Energy, Manufacturing, Chemical, Retail, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Hospitality, Pharmaceuticals, Banking & Financial Services, Transportation, Federal and State Government Agencies. Learn More About ProSidian Consulting at .Job DescriptionProSidian Seeks a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist \| Communications \[COC0076273\] for Program Support on a Exempt 1099 Contract: No Overtime Pay Basis Technical Element generally located across the CONUS - Charlotte, NC Across The Mid Atlantic Region supporting 0We seek 273 candidates with relevant Government And Public Services Sector Experience (functional and technical area expertise also ideal) to support professional services engagement for Government And Public Services Sector Clients such as COC. This as a Technical Element or Contract W-2 (IRS-1099) Communications Functional Area Professional - Digital Marketing Position; however, ProSidian reserves the right to convert to a Full-Time ProSidian employed W-2 Position.JOB OVERVIEWProvide services and support as a Digital Marketing (Senior Digital Marketing Specialist) in the Government And Public Services Industry Sector focussing on Human Capital Solutions for clients such as City of Charlotte (COC) \| Charlotte Cooperative Purchasing Alliance (CCPA) Generally Located In CONUS - Charlotte, NC and across the Mid Atlantic Region (Of Country/World).RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES - Senior Digital Marketing Specialist \| Communications \[COC0076273\]Develop multi-channel digital campaigns.Optimize SEO and SEM strategies.Manage analytics and reporting dashboards.Collaborate with content and design teams.Oversee email marketing campaigns.The role(s) are located in the Mid Atlantic Region is at or near CONUS - Charlotte, NC. Initially identified Work Site Address (Subject to Change or Working Remotely): 668 East 4th StreetCharlotte, NC 28202QualificationsDesired Qualifications For Senior Digital Marketing Specialist \| Communications \[COC0076273\] (COC0076273) Candidates:Proven success in digital marketing roles.Education / Experience Requirements / QualificationsBachelor’s in marketing or communications.5+ years’ digital marketing experience.Proven success in digital marketing roles.This position aligns with functional/technical service requirements and client engagements in the Government And Public Services Client Industry Sector: Government And Public Services (GPS) Sector Group: Driving Excellence In Service Delivery Through Government And Public Services Innovation And Partnership. Senior Digital Marketing Specialist \| Communications \[COC0076273\] Candidates shall work to support requirements for Communications Functional Area Services and shall work as a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist \| Communications \[COC0076273\].Skills RequiredPrimarily focused on Professional and Management Development Training initiatives and aligned with 273 activities 273 Functional Area Activities. SEO/SEM, Google Analytics, email automation.Competencies RequiredData-driven decision-making, adaptability, creativity.Ancillary Details Of The RolesManages digital ad budgets.Guides junior digital marketing staff.Other DetailsReports to Marketing Director.#TechnicalCrossCuttingJobs #Consulting #Government And Public Services #GovernmentSupportServices #ProfessionalAnalyticalSupport #Jugaad #Copitas #PokaYokeAdditional InformationAs a condition of employment, all employees are required to fulfill all requirements of the roles for which they are employed; establish, manage, pursue, and fulfill annual goals and objectives with at least three (3) Goals for each of the firms Eight Prosidian Global Competencies \[1 - Personal Effectiveness \| 2 - Continuous Learning \| 3 - Leadership \| 4 - Client Service \| 5 - Business Management \| 6 - Business Development \| 7 - Technical Expertise \| 8 - Innovation & Knowledge Sharing (Thought Leadership)\]; and to support all business development and other efforts on behalf of ProSidian Consulting.CORE COMPETENCIESTeamwork – ability to foster teamwork collaboratively as a participant, and effectively as a team leader
Leadership – ability to guide and lead colleagues on projects and initiatives
Business Acumen – understanding and insight into how organizations perform, including business processes, data, systems, and people
Communication – ability to effectively communicate to stakeholders of all levels orally and in writing
Motivation – persistent in pursuit of quality and optimal client and company solutions
Agility – ability to quickly understand and transition between different projects, concepts, initiatives, or work streams
Judgment – exercises prudence and insight in decision-making process while mindful of other stakeholders and long-term ramifications
Organization – ability to manage projects and activity, and prioritize tasks
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- ------------OTHER REQUIREMENTSBusiness Tools – understanding and proficiency with business tools and technology, including Microsoft Office. The ideal candidate is advanced with Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint and Word, and proficient with Adobe Acrobat, data analytic tools, and Visio with the ability to quickly learn other tools as necessary.
Commitment - to work with smart, interesting people with diverse backgrounds to solve the biggest challenges across private, public and social sectors
Curiosity – the ideal candidate exhibits an inquisitive nature and the ability to question the status quo among a community of people they enjoy and teams that work well together
Humility – exhibits grace in success and failure while doing meaningful work where skills have impact and make a difference
Willingness - to constantly learn, share, and grow and to view the world as their classroom
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- ------------BENEFITS AND HIGHLIGHTSProSidian Employee Benefits and Highlights: Your good health and well-being are important to ProSidian Consulting. At ProSidian, we invest in our employees to help them stay healthy and achieve work-life balance. That’s why we are also pleased to offer the Employee Benefits Program, designed to promote your health and personal welfare. Our growing list of benefits currently include the following for Full Time Employees:Competitive Compensation: Pay range begins in the competitive ranges with Group Health Benefits, Pre-tax Employee Benefits, and Performance Incentives. For medical and dental benefits, the Company contributes a fixed dollar amount each month towards the plan you elect. Contributions are deducted on a Pre-tax basis.
Group Medical Health Insurance Benefits: ProSidian partners with BC/BS, to offer a range of medical plans, including high-deductible health plans or PPOs. \|\|\| Group Dental Health Insurance Benefits: ProSidian dental carriers - Delta, Aetna, Guardian, and MetLife.
Group Vision Health Insurance Benefits: ProSidian offers high/low vision plans through 2 carriers: Aetna and VSP.
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: 401(k) Retirement Savings Plans help you save for your retirement for eligible employees. A range of investment options are available with a personal financial planner to assist you. The Plan is a pre-tax Safe Harbor 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a company match.
Vacation and Paid Time-Off (PTO) Benefits: Eligible employees use PTO for vacation, a doctor’s appointment, or any number of events in your life. Currently these benefits include Vacation/Sick days – 2 weeks/3 days \| Holidays - 10 ProSidian and Government Days are given.
Pre-Tax Payment Programs: Pre-Tax Payment Programs currently exist in the form of a Premium Only Plan (POP). These Plans offer a full Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Plan and a tax benefit for eligible employees.
Purchasing Discounts & Savings Plans: We want you to achieve financial success. We offer a Purchasing Discounts & Savings Plan through The Corporate Perks Benefit Program. This provides special discounts for eligible employees on products and services you buy on a daily basis.
Security Clearance: Due to the nature of our consulting engagements there are Security Clearance requirements for Engagement Teams handling sensitive Engagements in the Federal Marketplace. A Security Clearance is a valued asset in your professional portfolio and adds to your credentials.
ProSidian Employee & Contractor Referral Bonus Program: ProSidian Consulting will pay up to 5k for all referrals employed for 90 days for candidates submitted through our Referral Program.
Performance Incentives: Due to the nature of our consulting engagements there are performance incentives associated with each new client that each employee works to pursue and support.

# Senior Marketing Communications Manager

Kuros Biosciences, Inc.

[Alpharetta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Alpharetta%2C-GA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5562314304816419732?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10459&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1945590378462975757&crId=US_0US_0)

Position Overview

The Senior Marketing Communications Manager reports to the Marketing Communications Director and is primarily responsible for leading integrated marketing communications across Spine, Extremities and Trauma portfolios, serving as a senior strategic partner to Product Marketing, Sales, Clinical/Medical Affairs, Regulatory, and external agency/vendor partners.

Work Arrangement

- Full-time
- Hybrid: 3-days onsite in Alpharetta, GA

Responsibilities

This position requires an experienced marketer who can think both strategically and execute with precision - owning campaign development from insight to execution, translating the business or customer problem defined with cross functional leaders, writing creative briefs, aligning cross-functional partners, leading agency development, managing medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) approval, production, launch, and measuring results.

Integrated campaigns will support brand awareness, product adoption, sales enablement, and revenue growth across Spine, Extremities and Trauma. Success in this role requires both strong campaign judgment and hands-on execution across digital, email, social, events, sales tools, video, and print.

Campaign Strategy, Development & Execution

- Partner with internal Spine, Extremities and Trauma Product Marketing, Marketing Communications Director, Medical Affairs and Sales teams to translate priority customer needs, business objectives, competitive challenges, and content gaps into marketing communications campaigns.
- Develop and execute campaigns and product launches, translating launch strategies and product priorities into coordinated marketing communications, content, and campaign execution.
- Author clear, actionable campaign creative briefs that translate agreed business objectives and persona priorities into customer insight/problem, single-minded message, proof points, call to action, channel strategy, deliverables, success metrics, timeline, and budget parameters.
- Lead agency kickoff sessions and serve as the day-to-day campaign owner. Guide agency and internal creative partners through campaign concepting, copy development, design review, MLR preparation, production, launch, and post-launch optimization while maintaining brand voice and compliance requirements.
- Provide senior-level counsel on portfolio priorities, campaign sequencing, resource allocation, agency scope, and channel investment across Spine, Extremities, and Trauma.
- Translate technical product information, clinical evidence, surgeon feedback, and field insights into clear, audience-appropriate messaging and campaign concepts.
- Own post-launch campaign performance reviews by consolidating metrics, field feedback, and agency learnings, identify what worked, document improvements, and apply insights to the next campaign cycle.

Content Management

- Develop and execute integrated omnichannel campaigns across print, social, digital, email, video, web, event, and sales enablement resources, ensuring each tactic directly supports the approved campaign strategy and launch plan.
- Own the marketing workflow required to move materials through Veeva/MLR for submissions, annotations, version control, routing, tracking, and final approved-file management.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Clinical/Medical Affairs, Regulatory, and Sales to translate clinical evidence and product strategy into differentiated value propositions and compliant promotional messaging.

Sales Enablement Strategy & Tools

- Ensure Spine, Extremities and Trauma campaign and sales-enablement content is organized, current, easy to find, and appropriately deployed in our sales enablement platform, HighSpot, so sales representatives and distributors can use it effectively.
- Use HighSpot and campaign analytics to identify adoption, usage, content gaps, and opportunities to improve field activation; recommend actions rather than reporting metrics alone.

Market Research & Strategic Insight

- Lead focused qualitative or quantitative research to understand surgeon/customer needs, campaign response, competitive perceptions, and field opportunities.
- Analyze research, campaign performance, field feedback, and customer insights and translate them into clear implications for campaign strategy, messaging, content, and targeting.
- Maintain a prioritized campaign/content pipeline based on commercial priorities, competitive intelligence, customer feedback, evidence milestones, product launches, and identified market gaps.

Digital Marketing & Analytics

- Plan, develop and execute social media, website, email and texting campaign tactics as extensions of approved campaign strategy, ensuring brand voice consistency, message discipline, and compliance with guidelines.
- Collaborate with Marketing Communication peers to monitor and report on digital KPIs including social engagement, reach, click-through rate, lead conversion, email performance, and content usage to evaluate campaign performance and recommend optimizations.
- Collaborate with the Marketing Communications Director on website strategy, SEO priorities, landing pages, campaign pages, and content updates that support growth objectives.
- Manage Kuros U.S. Spine, Extremities and Trauma website content, owning updates and ensuring pages reflect current messaging, approved claims, product offerings, and campaign priorities.
- Build and deploy email campaigns in HubSpot for distributor partners and, where appropriate, surgeon audiences, ensuring content and cadence align with the active campaign brief.

Event & Tradeshow Execution

- Lead marketing execution for priority Spine, Extremities and Trauma trade shows based on strategy set by segment leaders/Product Management, including event graphics, collateral, advertising, and pre-/post-show communications.
- Partner with the Marketing Communications Director and Events team to set direction and deliver event marketing content and support follow-up and performance reporting.
- Lead marketing content and execution for education and advocacy events.

Team Collaboration

- Work closely with the Marketing Communications Director, other Marketing Communications peers, and Spine, Extremities and Trauma Managers/Directors to align positioning, launch priorities, campaign timing, claims, and cross-portfolio messaging.

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
- Experience: Minimum of seven years of progressive medical device experience in marketing communications, campaign development and management, healthcare marketing, medical device marketing, or a related commercial marketing role.
- Proven track record developing and launching integrated marketing campaigns, managing multiple integrated campaigns from strategic definition through MLR/approval, launch, field activation, and post-campaign performance analysis; product-launch experience is strongly preferred.

Preferred Experience

- Proven track record as a subject matter expert in spine, orthopedics, extremities, trauma, biologics, or another surgeon-focused device category is strongly preferred.
- Advanced project-management and prioritization skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple deadlines, owners, agencies, approvals, and dependencies without losing strategic focus or executional detail.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate expectations clearly, facilitate decisions, give actionable creative feedback, and present recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
- Experience in understanding and interfacing with HCPs and/or field sales organizations.
- Proficiency with Microsoft applications including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
- Hands-on experience managing organic and paid social media content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, including campaign setup, content publishing, audience targeting, performance monitoring, and optimization.
- Experience with Veeva or a comparable MLR/quality system and familiarity with medical-device or regulated-industry promotional review requirements.
- Proficiency with enablement tools such as HubSpot and HighSpot used to support campaign execution and sales enablement.

Skills

- Campaign strategy and ownership: able to diagnose the business/customer problem, identify the campaign needed, define the brief and audience journey, set direction, and own execution through launch and optimization.
- Creative brief writing: clear, focused, audience-specific, strategically reasoned, and actionable enough for an agency or internal partner to execute against.
- Agency and stakeholder management: experienced in leading kickoffs, reviewing creative work, managing feedback, and holding partners to strategy, branding and timing.
- Integrated campaign execution: able to connect content, print, email, social, web, events, and sales enablement into one coordinated launch plan.
- Sales enablement: able to translate campaign strategy into practical field tools, rollout communications, and resources on HighSpot that sales and distributor partners will use.
- Insight translation: able to turn research, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and performance data into clear marketing decisions rather than simply summarizing findings.
- Digital and email execution: hands-on ability to build, launch and measure digital/email tactics including social and HubSpot email campaigns.
- Launch and event execution: able to manage detailed launch/event plans, dependencies, timelines, field communication, lead follow-up, and measurement.
- Ownership & collaboration: proactive, accountable, organized, receptive to feedback, able to lead with a high degree of independence, and skilled at keeping cross-functional partners aligned.

Travel Requirement

- Up to 20-30% travel, with ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager

News Break

[Mountain View, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Mountain-View%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4078917209570110733?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7556&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2558133949745302086&crId=US_0US_0)

About NewsBreakFounded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit Why this role existsThe team has a Lead, and direction is well set — the agentic system is their initiative. But that same person also heads the part-time jobs vertical. Two significant roles, one person's bandwidth means the time available for paid growth is limited. Day-to-day operations are covered by a colleague who is new to growth — at this budget scale, incrementality judgment, bidding strategy, and experiment design sit beyond their current experience. What's missing isn't direction; it's an experienced operator running the function full-time. That colleague will continue on execution under you.That explains the present state: no incrementality testing has ever been run, a hyper-local product bids uniformly nationwide, angle tests run without pre-registered sample sizes or stopping rules, and close to half the team still performs work the platforms have automated. Conservatively, eight figures of annual efficiency sits unclaimed here.Platform automation has absorbed most manual optimization headroom — the ceiling isn't operational precision. Experiment design and analytical judgment are the core skills; knowing the Meta interface is table stakes.What you'll ownCross-channel budget reallocation grounded in incrementalityStandardizing how angles get tested — the most concrete gap today: pre-registered sample sizes and power calculations, success criteria and stopping rules set before launch, a consistent control, a structured test log, and strict separation of message tests from creative tests (never vary both). Testing happens today, but conclusions are of uncertain reliability: the true hit rate is unknown, and winners may have been killed while noise was keptGuardrails and supervision for the agentic bidding system: approval thresholds, audit logs, rollback, enforced holdouts, and when to trust it versus intervene. The Lead sets system direction; this role owns rollout and risk controlRollout of geo-tiered biddingExtracting platform support — at this spend level you should have rep support, lift studies, and alpha accessRebalancing the team: nearly half of it still does work the platforms have automatedWhat we're looking for7+ years in app UA, having independently run $30M+ per year — small-budget experience doesn't transfer; this bar is firmYou can answer: “Given a system that reallocates budget automatically, how do you stop it from moving spend toward zero-incrementality inventory?”You've cut spend that looked good in the dashboard but wasn't incrementalYou design your own experiments, including power calculations and stopping rulesYou've managed 4+ people, including at least one non-buying function (analytics, creative, or engineering)Industry openFirst 90 daysAudit optimization events: how much budget sits on installs versus downstream valueWith the Growth DS, translate the first incrementality readout into actual budget shiftsStand up the two-layer testing framework and ring-fence an exploration budgetThe US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Pay may vary based on a number of factors including job-related skills, level, experience, geographic location and relevant education or training. At NewsBreak, we design our overall rewards package to attract top talents. Depending on the position, the role may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and options. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.Annual Base Pay Range$100,000—$250,000 USDCPRA Privacy Notice for California Candidates

### \[Full-time\] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.

## **About This Role**

We're looking for a **Senior Performance Marketing Manager** to own paid user acquisition end to end.

You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable.

This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit.

### Key Responsibilities

- Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it.
- Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working
- Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting
- Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy
- Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop
- Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback
- Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue.
- Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments
- Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next
- Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy—and flag it loudly when they aren't
- Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity
- Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight

#### Requirements

- 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment
- Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)—you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency
- Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through
- Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else
- Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations—you know when a number is directional vs. reliable
- Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume
- Demonstrated CRO instincts and experience partnering on landing page and funnel testing
- Clear written communication—you can explain performance and tradeoffs to a leadership audience without a translator
- Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you set your own priorities

About Wear Felicity
Wear Felicity is a fast-growing e-commerce jewelry brand that helps people celebrate what they love most. We currently invest heavily in paid acquisition across Meta, TikTok, Google, and AppLovin. We are looking for a high-performance operator to take over our $12M+/year ad budget and fuel our next stage of growth.

Role Overview
You will pilot a $12M+/year budget. Your job is to manage the architecture of our ad accounts, maintain our efficiency targets (MER/Contribution Margin), and tell the Creative Team exactly what data points lead to revenue.

What You’ll Do

High-Volume Media Buying: Own the day-to-day execution and bid management across Meta, TikTok, Google (PMax/YouTube), and AppLovin.

Financial Pacing: You are the bank. You manage daily budgets to ensure we hit monthly revenue targets without breaking our efficiency thresholds (MER/CAC).

Account Architecture: Structure campaigns for scale. You know when to use ASC vs. manual controls, and you are obsessed with clean data and exclusions.

The "Truth" Source: You own the attribution (Northbeam). You tell the team what is actually working, separate from platform vanity metrics.

Feedback Loop: You don't make the ads, but you grade them. You provide weekly reports to the Creative Lead on which angles, formats, and landing pages are driving the highest LTV customers.

What We’re Looking For

3–5+ years of pure performance marketing. You have logged thousands of hours in Ads Manager.

High-Spend Experience: You have managed a single account spending $500k+/month .

Analytical Obsession: You live in Excel/Sheets. You make decisions based on statistical significance, not gut feeling.

Platform Fluency: Deep technical knowledge of Meta Advantage+, Google PMax, and TikTok Smart Performance Campaigns. Experience with AppLovin is a plus.

3–5+ years of performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on media buying expertise.

Proven track record of profitably managing large-scale e-commerce budgets ($500k+/mo).

Strong analytical skills and platform fluency (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Excel/Sheets).

Creative thinker who knows how to generate, test, and scale winning ad angles.

Experience with mobile ad platforms (AppLovin or similar) is a strong plus.

Results-driven, proactive, and able to thrive in a fast-paced growth environment.

Competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and career growth opportunities.

Join a rapidly scaling DTC brand with a meaningful mission.

Your work directly impacts company growth and revenue.

Creative, collaborative team environment where your ideas are valued.

Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage.

Remote-friendly, flexible work environment.

- Manage and optimize high-spend Meta advertising accounts
- Own day-to-day budget, campaign, testing, and optimization decisions
- Analyze performance and troubleshoot changes or declines
- Evaluate creative performance and provide actionable feedback on why ads are or aren’t working
- Work across multiple DTC e-commerce client accounts
- Present performance insights and recommendations directly to clients
- Stay current on Meta and continually test new strategies and approaches
- Over time, take on responsibility for leading a small pod of media buyers

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field
- 5+ years of digital advertising, PPC, or performance marketing experience
- **Experience personally managing significant Meta ad spend, ideally approaching $1M+ per month**
- **DTC ecommerce marketing experience — required, not preferred**
- Deep, hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager
- Proficient with 3rd-party attribution tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, or equivalent
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making — comfortable in Excel and GA
- Excellent copywriting skills and strong instincts for creative performance
- Experience on client calls — able to present recommendations and build strong relationships
- Available for video calls during US business hours (ET/CT)
- Fluent in English (written and verbal)

**Why Join Us?**

You’ll work across brands with significant media spend and have the autonomy to test, learn, and try new approaches. This role offers the chance to stay hands-on in media buying while continuing to grow your responsibility and leadership experience.

We are seeking a Sr. Manager of Performance Marketing to oversee development and execution of all digital growth marketing efforts across DTC and Retail of our Dorel Juvenile Group USA branded websites: Maxi-Cosi, Safety 1st, COSCO Kids, Tiny Love, Little Seeds, and Monbebe.
Specific focus will center on paid search marketing, paid social marketing, programmatic display, affiliate marketing, and all other digital customer acquisition and paid lead generation advertising channels.
Your mission Reporting to the Director of Integrated Marketing this role will be successful through close collaboration with the brand marketing, creative, product management, sales and external agencies, to set the digital advertising and customer acquisition strategy for revenue growth on our direct sales channels along with specific retail channels.
This position does not support immigration sponsorship now or in the future.
Key responsibilities Own the performance & lifecycle marketing programs for our portfolio of brands and select retail partners
Manage omni-retail marketers who manage retail partners such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, & Babylist
Lead the development, execution and optimization of full-funnel advertising strategies across our marketing mix – including paid search, paid social, affiliate, display, CTV, and Email/SMS
Partner with external media agencies to develop and drive strategy while ensuring that performance across all placements is meeting goals and profitability targets
Manage the forecasting and tracking of budgets for digital media plans – collaborating with Finance to ensure proper pacing throughout the year
Monitor campaign performance, extract insights, and continuously optimized to drive efficiency in media placements through the funnel
Explore new areas of opportunity, ensuring that we are always testing into new mediums where we can speak to the target audience
Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to connect upper-funnel storytelling with performance impact throughout the customer journey
Partner with IT to ensure all tracking, coding, and tags are working properly
Your profile Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or related field.
4-6 years of experience and 2+ years of people management experience. Agency experience a plus.
Technical proficiency required in Google Analytics, Google AdWords, Meta Business Manager. Experience in other social advertising platforms, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center a plus.
Experience with email marketing through Klayvio.
Deep working knowledge across all digital marketing channels.
Proficient computer skills, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel.)
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and ever-changing environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as strong presentation capabilities.
Must be able to set the tone for channel specific creative/messaging approach to drive success while collaborating with Marketing & Sales partners to write briefs, execute campaigns, and create recap reports.
Excellent analytical skills.
Strong project management skills with the ability to supervise multiple projects.
Ability to customize management style to lead and inspire teams.
Salary range posted:
$100,000 - $130,000

# Senior Paid Media Manager

$3,000 - $3,500 per month

BM Digital

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-663093164723415406?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5990698178619417610&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Paid Media Specialist

You'll own paid media end to end for a set of DTC and e-commerce accounts: onboarding a new client, building their accounts from scratch, and running live campaigns against revenue targets. You're the person the client speaks to about their spend. You explain what's working, what isn't, and what you're doing about it.

This is a hands-on seat, not an oversight one. You run the accounts yourself.

##### What You Own

Onboarding a new client

- Lead the kickoff: budgets, targets (CPA/ROAS), audiences, and reporting cadence
- Audit existing ad accounts, tracking setup, and creative libraries before anything goes live
- Agree what good looks like in month one, three, and six

Setting up

- Configure ad accounts, pixels, CAPI, and conversion tracking
- Build the account structure: campaigns, ad sets, audiences, budget splits
- Brief creative and feed requirements to the studio team

Running the account

- Launch, monitor, and optimise daily against KPIs
- Manage budget pacing and move spend where it performs
- Run creative, audience, and bidding tests, then scale what works
- Own the weekly and monthly client reporting and walk clients through it
- Flag risks early. If a target is slipping, the client hears it from you first, with a plan

##### What You Need

- 3+ years buying paid media, hands-on, across Meta and Google (TikTok a plus)
- A track record in DTC or e-commerce where you owned ROAS or CPA and can talk through specific accounts
- Comfortable running client calls solo, including the difficult ones about performance
- Strong on tracking and attribution: GA4, pixel, CAPI, and reading the data behind a result
- Able to run several accounts at once, start to finish, and keep each one on plan

##### Nice to Have

- Agency background running multiple clients
- Feed management and Google Shopping experience
- A creative testing framework you've actually used

Pay Rate: $3,000-3,500 USD

Datasite and its associated businesses are the global center for facilitating economic value creation for companies across the globe. From data rooms to AI deal sourcing

and more. Here you’ll find the finest technological pioneers: Datasite, Blueflame AI, Grata, and Sherpany. They all, collectively, define the future for business growth.

Apply for one position or as many as you like. Talent doesn’t always just go in one direction or fit in a single box. We’re happy to see whatever your superpower is and find the best place for it to flourish.

Get started now, we look forward to meeting you.

Job Description
We’re looking for a Senior Paid Media Manager to take ownership of Sherpany’s paid media strategy and turn investment into measurable growth.
This is a hands‑on role for someone who loves the combination of performance marketing, experimentation and commercial results. You’ll own our paid activity across Google and LinkedIn, continuously testing and optimizing what works, while identifying opportunities to expand into channels such as YouTube and Meta.
You won’t just be driving clicks. You’ll be focused on what happens further down the funnel - generating high-quality demand, contributing to pipeline and maximizing return on our investment.
What you’ll do

Own our paid media strategy: Plan, build and optimize campaigns across Google Search, LinkedIn, Display and retargeting, with the opportunity to introduce and test new channels.

Drive paid search performance: Manage Google Search end-to-end, from keyword and bidding strategy to ad copy, landing page alignment, budget allocation and ongoing optimization.

Scale paid social: Lead our LinkedIn advertising, including Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms and other formats. Develop audience strategies and continuously test messaging, creative and targeting.

Build effective retargeting journeys: Create thoughtful multi-channel retargeting strategies, managing audience sequencing, frequency and conversion.

Experiment and innovate: Identify opportunities to improve our existing channel mix and build the business case for new platforms, formats and approaches.

Turn data into action: Monitor performance closely, spot trends and opportunities, and translate insights into clear actions.

Own commercial performance: Manage budgets with discipline and continuously optimize toward CPL, pipeline contribution and ROAS.

Collaborate across the team: Partner closely with Content, Design and the wider Marketing team to develop campaigns and creative that resonate with our audiences.

What you bring

Strong hands‑on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, including meaningful paid media budgets.

A track record of improving performance and delivering measurable commercial results, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology or another considered‑purchase environment.

Strong knowledge of campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience development, conversion tracking and retargeting.

A genuinely data‑driven mindset - you enjoy watching performance develop, digging into the numbers, spotting patterns and figuring out what to optimize next.

A commercial approach to performance marketing: you care about pipeline and return on investment, not just impressions and clicks.

Strong budget management skills and confidence making decisions about where to increase, reduce or reallocate spend.

An experimental mindset and curiosity about new channels, formats and approaches.

Experience with YouTube or Meta Ads is a plus, but curiosity and the willingness to build expertise in new channels is equally important.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations for colleagues and stakeholders.

BANA LAW

BANA LAWBANA LAW, PC is a California plaintiff-side personal injury firm headquartered in Los Angeles. We represent people who have been seriously injured, and the families of those who have been killed, in cases across the state. Paid media is a core driver of our business. We run a monthly budget concentrated entirely in California, the most competitive and most expensive legal advertising market in the country.
About the Role We are hiring a senior paid media operator to take ownership of our paid advertising program. Google Ads is the emphasis of this role and the primary measure of success. You will also own our Social Media (primarily Meta: Instagram and Facebook) paid program. Setting strategy, managing budget and performance, and directing creative and audience testing, whether executing it directly or overseeing an agency or freelancer. This is not a rebuild. We own our Google Ads accounts, full conversion history, call tracking, and landing pages. Whoever we hire takes the wheel of a functioning, well-instrumented program and is expected to make it materially better. This is a senior individual contributor role today. As the paid media function grows, you will hire and lead a team, starting with dedicated social media specialists working under your direction. We are looking for someone genuinely excellent at Google Ads, not a generalist who has touched it, and not someone who managed personal injury accounts as one of twenty logos at an agency. If you have run seven figure annual personal injury search budgets and can walk us through exactly what you did, why, and what it produced, we want to talk to you.
Responsibilities Google Ads (Primary Focus)
Full ownership of the Google Ads account across California
Campaign architecture, keyword strategy, negative keyword systems, search term management, ad copy, extensions, and a disciplined testing cadence.
Full ownership of Google Local Services Ads across all California markets, including budget, service area configuration, review velocity strategy, and lead scoring.
Bid strategy and budget deployment. We set the total budget; you recommend how to allocate it across California counties and case types, and defend the recommendation with data.
Call tracking and lead quality: CallRail configuration, tracking numbers, call scoring, and feeding call data back into the ad platforms.
Offline conversion tracking: building and maintaining the pipeline from Lead Docket and Filevine, surfaced through Domo, back into Google Ads so bidding optimizes toward signed cases and case value, not form fills.
Google Ads scripts for budget pacing, anomaly detection, search term analysis, and automated reporting.
Ongoing competitive and auction intelligence across the California legal advertising landscape.
Meta (Instagram & Facebook)
Own strategy, budget, and performance for our Meta paid program: campaign structure, audience and lookalike targeting, and offer strategy.
Direct creative and audience testing cadence, whether producing creative yourself or briefing and managing an agency or freelancer.
Apply the same lead-quality and attribution discipline used on Google: connect Meta spend to qualified leads and signed cases, not just clicks or engagement.
Evaluate and recommend whether creative execution should stay outsourced or move in-house as the program scales.
Build and maintain KPI dashboards.
Present recommendations directly to firm leadership.
How We Will Measure You Cost per signed case
Quality of leads and signed cases.
Case value and case-type mix, not just lead or engagement volume
Return on ad spend and the efficiency of every incremental dollar, across both channels
Qualifications 5+ years managing Google Ads, including meaningful time at seven figure annual spend. This is the core of the role and the bar is high.
Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, with a commitment to staying current on platform updates, trends, and best practices.
Direct personal injury advertising experience. This is a requirement, not a preference. California experience is strongly preferred; experience in another highly competitive state market will be considered.
Deep, hands-on Google Local Services Ads experience.
Working experience managing Meta paid campaigns (Instagram and Facebook), including audience targeting, budget management, and creative testing. You do not need to be a designer, but you need to know what good creative testing looks like and be able to run or direct it.
Demonstrated experience implementing offline conversion imports and value-based bidding.
Working proficiency with Google Ads scripts. You should be able to read, modify, deploy, and troubleshoot scripts on your own.
Strong analytical ability and fluency working in a BI environment. Domo experience is a plus; the ability to learn it quickly is required.
The judgment to tell the difference between signal and noise, and the discipline not to over-manage the account.
Clear, direct written communication. You will present recommendations to firm leadership and are expected to have a point of view.
Preferred Skills Google Ads API experience.
SQL.
Prior experience managing or scaling a Meta paid program specifically within personal injury or another high-CPC, high-competition vertical.
Familiarity with Filevine, Lead Docket, or comparable legal case management and intake platforms.
Current Google Ads certifications.
Prior experience hiring or managing a paid media team.

This role builds, optimizes, troubleshoots, and scales complex paid acquisition systems to improve cost-per-case, lead quality, and overall case acquisition outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** - Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads, Bing, Performance Max, YouTube, and Microsoft Ads campaigns. - # Senior SEO Specialist

Decisionpoint Corporation

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6572385698913583954?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7520809864704599445&crId=US_0US_0)

**Overview**

DecisionPoint seeks a **Senior SEO Specialist** to lead enterprise-wide search engine optimization strategy in support of a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role develops long-term SEO roadmaps, defines baseline metrics, oversees monthly technical and performance analysis, and ensures all SEO activities advance organizational priorities and audience needs.

The Senior SEO Specialist will serve as the subject matter expert guiding SEO implementation across digital content, websites, tools, and communications products. This role ensures adherence to best practices in technical SEO, content optimization, analytics interpretation, and integrated digital strategy.

This position is fully remote.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

The Senior SEO Specialist will:

- Lead the enterprise SEO program, including strategy development, KPIs, governance standards, and implementation oversight.

- Establish baseline SEO metrics and performance targets across MC&FP's digital ecosystem.

- Conduct technical SEO audits including site speed, indexing, metadata, schema, internal linking, redirects, and crawl health.

- Oversee monthly SEO reporting and actionable insights for leadership and program teams.

- Develop and maintain keyword strategies to support content planning and communication priorities.

- Ensure content adheres to SEO best practices including metadata optimization, heading structures, alt text, evergreen maintenance, and link hygiene.

- Collaborate with UX, content, analytics, and development teams on SEO-informed enhancements.

- Guide schema markup, structured data, and specialized technical SEO configurations.

- Monitor algorithm changes, emerging search trends, and digital behaviors to inform strategy updates.

- Train stakeholders and staff on SEO practices and tools.

- Provide recommendations for continual improvement across content, technical architecture, and site governance.

**Qualifications**

**Clearance Requirement**

Candidate must possess a **Tier 2 Moderate Risk Public Trust (from any federal agency)** or an **active Secret clearance or higher** .

**Education (Required)**

BA/BS in Marketing, Digital Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field.

**Experience (Required)**

- Minimum **10 years** of experience leading SEO strategy and implementing large-scale SEO programs.

- Experience conducting technical SEO audits and developing enterprise SEO roadmaps.

- Demonstrated success improving rankings, visibility, and organic engagement for complex websites.

- Experience with SEO performance reporting and analytics interpretation.

**Technical Knowledge (Required)**

- Deep understanding of search engine algorithms, ranking factors, and technical SEO principles.

- Proficiency with SEO tools (e.g., Google Search Console, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs).

- Understanding of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript as applied to SEO.

- Knowledge of schema markup, structured data, and indexing controls.

- Experience working with content management systems and digital asset governance.

**Technical Knowledge (Preferred)**

- Experience supporting SEO in federal, DoD, nonprofit, or large multi-platform environments.

- Familiarity with accessibility standards and Section 508 compliance.

**Skills**

- Strong analytical and strategic planning abilities.

- Excellent communication skills for presenting insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across digital, content, and technical teams.

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and SEO best-practice discipline.

- Ability to manage multiple initiatives and drive measurable improvements.

# Senior Ad Operations Specialist - Client Operations

Madhive

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3075054107883084375?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5644681949019961867&crId=US_0US_0)

Madhive is the leading independent and fully customizable operating system built to help local media professionals build profitable, differentiated, and efficient businesses. Madhive empowers sales teams to extend their reach into streaming and connects local advertisers with the communities they serve. Madhive’s platform provides the unique ability to reach local audiences at national scale, with premium supply partnerships and end-to-end tools for planning, targeting, and measuring full-funnel campaign outcomes. Powering campaigns for over 30,000 small and medium businesses per day, Madhive is driving the evolution of local media.
Madhive is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Ad Operations Specialist to play a key role in the end-to-end support of our programmatic advertising campaigns. You’ll bring hands‑on expertise across multiple buying platforms and act as a go‑to resource for inquiries and troubleshooting relating to our campaigns and user platform. This is a great next step for someone who’s mastered the fundamentals of ad operations and is ready to take on more strategic and technical responsibility within the team.
What You’ll Do Triage platform issues, perform troubleshooting, report bugs to Engineering, and provide updates to stakeholders
Investigate programmatic campaign configuration issues and collaborate across teams to implement fixes
Configure website tracking pixels and troubleshoot pixel placement
Address client inquiries regarding campaign capabilities and behaviors; provide client support over emails and calls
Proactively provide campaign tactic and configuration recommendations based on client objectives
Identify workflow inefficiencies and propose solutions to improve operational speed and accuracy
Participate in building team resources such as documentation and training materials
Independently manage workload and maintain accountability for any assigned tasks
Lead small projects or audits
Who You Are Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
3-5 years of hands‑on experience in digital ad operations, media buying, or campaign management.
Proficient in ad serving platforms, DSPs, and tracking systems (experience with multiple platforms preferred).
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; comfortable navigating data to drive decisions.
Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational discipline.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced environment and takes ownership of results.
Passionate about advertising technology and continuous learning in an evolving ecosystem.
The approximate compensation range for this position is $42,200-$55,000 The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.
We are Madhive Madhive is a dynamic, diverse, innovative, and friendly place to work. We embrace our differences and believe they fuel our creativity. We come from varied backgrounds and think that’s important. Whether it’s taking ideas from previous lives and applying them in different ways or creating something completely new, we are all trail‑blazing team players who think big and want to make an impact.
We are committed to cultivating a culture of inclusion and collaboration. We welcome diversity in education, culture, opinions, race, ethnicity, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs.

# Senior Media Buyer

$85k - $100k

Full-time

ICON International, Inc.

[Fort Lauderdale, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Fort-Lauderdale%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/802029354530331991?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9251&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3272378801019127373&crId=US_0US_0)

**Position Description**

As a Senior Media Investment Lead, you will negotiate local media buys and manage all aspects of stewardship. You will also oversee an Associate on daily tasks and workload while supporting their mentorship and development. The ideal candidate is flexible and able to adapt their approach based on marketplace dynamics and evolving client needs, using experience and sound judgment to achieve goals.

**Essential Functions:**

- Negotiate local radio and television media buys; digital video experience is a plus.
- Assess local market conditions, audience trends, and competitive media activity.

Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer (Client-Facing)

Job Overview

MVR Digital is hiring a Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer to own Meta strategy and execution for a small portfolio of our largest premium and luxury DTC accounts. You will be in Ads Manager daily building, testing, and scaling campaigns. You will also set the strategy and defend it on client calls.

Agency work moves fast. Priorities shift mid-week, platforms change without warning, and a client can ask for a new direction on a Friday. We need someone who adjusts quickly, keeps their accounts organized while doing it, and keeps clients feeling looked after the whole way through.

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency working with premium and luxury DTC and e-commerce brands to grow profitably online. Adweek named us one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We work across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV, plus email, creative, and landing pages. The team is fully remote, direct, and focused on results.

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner
- Clarity over Complexity
- Serve Clients’ Best Interest
- We Win Together, We Lose Together
- Data-Informed, Human-Led

What Success Looks Like

Your mission is to run 2 to 4 client accounts, each spending $300K+ a month on Meta, so that performance moves toward target without leadership in the daily details. In your first year:

- By month 4, 80% or more of your accounts are green against their monthly goals
- Zero client-seen launch errors each quarter
- Every test closes with a written verdict in the change log
- By month 3, fewer than 2 media questions a month reach leadership from your clients
- Clients get a clear answer on urgent requests the same business day

What You Will Do

- Own Meta strategy and daily execution across your accounts: build, structure, budget pacing, testing, and scaling
- Manage $100K+ per month in Meta spend per account against MER, ROAS, and CPA targets
- Change course quickly when performance, a client request, or the platform shifts, and tell the client what changed and why
- Keep every account organized: clean naming, current change logs, documented tests, and pacing you can show at any time
- Configure and QA tracking yourself: pixel, CAPI, event quality, catalog, and feed health
- Run structured creative testing. Brief creative, critique what comes back, and connect creative performance to your in-platform decisions
- Support Google, TikTok, and other channels where they affect your accounts, and hold a point of view on cross-channel budget allocation
- Lead the Meta portion of client calls. Explain performance clearly, bring a recommendation, and push back when a request will not serve the client
- Respond to clients promptly and professionally, including when the news is bad

What We Are Looking For

- 4+ years of hands-on paid social at an agency or high-growth brand
- Personally owned Meta budgets of $300K+ per month on at least one account, with documented efficiency gains
- Deep Meta expertise: Advantage+, CBO, signal quality, CAPI, and incrementality
- DTC or e-commerce ownership. Premium or luxury AOV experience is a strong differentiator
- A track record of managing several high-spend accounts at once without anything slipping
- Strong client service instincts: you respond quickly, set expectations early, and stay calm under pressure
- Working Google Ads knowledge. You do not need Google depth, but you can speak to it credibly
- GA4, Looker Studio, Shopify, and attribution fluency
- Fluent, confident English and strong client communication. This role is client-facing
- Comfortable in a fast-moving remote environment where priorities change

Role Details

- Full-time independent contractor
- Fully remote. Based in the US or Canada, with overlap with EST time zones for client calls

Perks

- Paid time off
- Paid company holidays
- Flexible Fridays
- Remote-first collaboration
- Quarterly bonus opportunities

**Location:** Remote / North America / EST preferred

**Company:** SimplePin

**About SimplePin**

SimplePin provides financial automation technology to mid-market and enterprise insurance agencies and brokerages across North America.

With established products, customers, and industry relationships, we're ready to accelerate our growth in this highly specialized market. We're looking for an ambitious B2B marketer who can help make SimplePin one of the most recognized and sought-after technology providers in our industry.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager will own the planning, execution, and optimization of SimplePin’s marketing efforts across channels. This role is equal parts **strategy, analytics, and creativity**—ideal for someone who understands how to use data and tools like **HubSpot** to target the right audience, deliver the right message, at the right time.

You’ll be responsible for campaign execution, performance reporting, audience segmentation, and content development, while working closely with sales, partnerships, and leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **Demand Generation:** Develop and execute campaigns that generate qualified leads, sales opportunities, and pipeline growth.
- **Brand Awareness:** Build SimplePin's recognition and credibility through industry campaigns, partnerships, events, and thought leadership.
- **Content & SEO:** Drive customer testimonials, case studies, videos, webinars, and website content. Improve organic search rankings and visibility in Google and AI-powered search.
- **Marketing Operations:** Own HubSpot campaigns, segmentation, automation, reporting, and performance measurement.
- **Execution:** Develop the marketing plan, manage priorities, and coordinate internal and external resources to deliver measurable results.

**Why Join SimplePin?**

- **Own the function:** Take responsibility for marketing strategy and execution, with direct access to leadership.
- **Accelerate your career:** Gain broader exposure, greater responsibility, and the opportunity to demonstrate measurable achievements.
- **Make an impact:** Help establish SimplePin as a recognized leader in a focused, high-value industry.
- **Get support:** Access external specialists for design, video, SEO, and other marketing initiatives.
- **Make your mark:** This is a hands-on individual contributor role with the autonomy to lead marketing and build a track record of results that accelerates your career.

**Qualifications**

- 3-5 years of experience in a marketing role, preferably in **fintech, SaaS, or B2B**
- **Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot**(campaigns, reporting, workflows)
- Proven ability to interpret data and turn insights into action
- Experience creating and managing marketing content and campaigns end-to-end
- Strong organizational and project management skills
- Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Leadership
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Nice to Have**

- Familiarity with CRM integrations and marketing automation best practices
- Event or conference marketing experience
- Basic design or content editing skills (Canva, Figma, etc.)

Looking forward to meeting you!

Job DescriptionAt K&L Gates, we are looking for smart, imaginative and hard-working people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas to join us. Perhaps our search for talented visionaries and your search for important and impactful work lead to the same place.As a member of the Global Client Growth team, the Market Development Senior Manager will have responsibility for developing and executing marketing and business development programs for the firm’s financial services industry team and asset management and investment funds practice group The Market Development Senior Manager will collaborate with respective firm and industry leadership, as well as individual lawyers and members of Client Growth, to help strategize, plan, and support current and future-focused market development activities with special attention on go-to-market strategy, pipeline development, and sales enablement. Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:Go-To-Market Strategy: • Work with leadership to identify market opportunities and target audiences and co-develop and implement industry-centric business development strategies consistent with the firm’s strategic initiatives• Collaborate closely with lawyers and members of Client Growth’s content development and events teams to develop and manage, from inception to completion, market-specific content campaigns, marketing collateral, and events with a goal of increasing visibility of industry capabilities and generating client opportunities • Maintain a strong knowledge of the respective markets, including business trends and competitive landscape for legal services • Identify potential press opportunities and collaborate with the public relations team to turn these opportunities into media exposure; identify lawyers to be sources with key media contacts• Collaborate to provide insight and feedback on industry goals for rankings and awards; determine strategic categories and lawyers for focus and inclusionPipeline Development: • Develop and drive pipeline development process and lead the key account program within the financial services industry team • Identify revenue expansion opportunities and develop cross-market initiatives by matching firm solutions to client needs within specific markets and/or practices• Develop and maintain personal connections in the business community to help in lead generationBusiness Development:• Collaborate with lawyers to execute business development activities and plans using resources across the firm’s network for support• Work closely with lawyers, other Client Growth team members, and firmwide personnel to develop a strategic approach to significant opportunities and assist the pitches and proposals team with creating proposal content, preparing RFP responses, writing proposals, creating presentations, and maintaining industry qualifications for new business• Support business development efforts by identifying potential leads, collecting and sharing market and industry intelligence, representing the firm at networking events, tracking business development activity, identifying professional and trade associations with which we should affiliate• Coach lawyers as they prepare for significant business development opportunities, follow up on outcomes, and conduct client debriefings Industry Team Management: • Own the documentation, management, and transfer of the industry’s business development and marketing norms and protocols and ensure that all team members globally are equipped with the institutional knowledge to support the industry• Manage knowledge bank of relevant lawyer experience• Strategize and co-develop annual marketing and business development budget with leadership• Assist in orienting new lawyers by communicating Client Growth’s department structure and capabilities, and helping with initial integration into the firm and business development activities• Assist in the mentoring, training and ongoing development of teammates • Serve as a member of Client Growth team through executing firm wide initiatives as assigned and participating in other projectsKnowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:• Minimum of seven years of marketing, business development and/or sales experience in a professional services firm or closely related work environment; experience within a large national or international firm preferred• Extensive knowledge of the financial services industry. • MBA or similar graduate-level degree preferred• Outstanding communication skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with individuals at all levels, including ability to influence senior professionals and help them succeed in meeting their business development objectives• Ability to work independently with a willingness to work hands-on to achieve objectives in an environment with little leverage• Outstanding project management skills and the ability to juggle competing, shifting priorities• Excellent attention to detail• Consistent ability to meet deadlines• Collaborative, team-oriented approach to workWorking Conditions:• Manual dexterity required for typing, reaching and lifting of small objects, and operating office equipment• Frequent computer use at workstation for extended periods of time • Responsibilities occasionally may require an adjusted work schedule in order to meet deadlines• Mobility within the office including movement from floor to floor• Access information using a computer• Effectively manages and communicates confidential issuesCompensation Salary $112,000 - $216,000 / yearThe compensation salary for this position will be determined during the interview process and will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to prior experience, relevant expertise, current business needs, and market factors.ABOUT THE FIRMK&L Gates is a fully integrated global law firm with lawyers located in more than 40 offices. We have experienced dramatic growth in the past decade and now rank among the largest U.S. based law firms in the world. We take pride in constantly striving for innovation, imagination and an entrepreneurial spirit. We come up with big ideas and then roll up our sleeves to get the job done, guiding our clients through their most complex issues in a variety of industry sectors and across multiple regions of the world. The industry recognition the firm has garnered emanates from the foundation of a global community aligned on behalf of our clients. The people at K&L Gates are committed to working together to create a legacy for each other, the firm, our clients, and the communities in which we serve.
