# Senior Product Marketing Manager, MSSP

Full-time

SentinelOne

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2959203770536460957?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5853291701606411733&crId=US_0US_0)

### Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, MSSP, you will be tasked with owning messaging and content for the MSSP (Managed Security Service Provider) audience, a distinct buyer with its own economics, delivery model, and competitive set. You'll translate SentinelOne's platform story into positioning, content, and enablement that helps MSSPs sell, deliver, and scale on top of our platform. You'll work closely with teams across Marketing, Partner, Sales, and Product to create and maintain MSSP-specific messaging.

### What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Own the MSSP-specific messaging, including pricing/packaging language, multi-tenant management, co-managed vs. fully-managed models, and margin/economics framing that resonates with partner leadership.
- Keep MSSP positioning aligned to corporate narrative while adapting it to a partner lens.
- Maintain a clear point of view on how SentinelOne's platform model reduces MSSP operational overhead versus point-tool stacks.
- Build and maintain the MSSP partner enablement kit, including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and sales plays tailored to how MSSPs sell and deliver.
- Develop MSSP-specific case studies and proof points, and adapt existing customer proof points for a partner-delivery narrative.
- Produce webinars, partner newsletters, and co-marketing content in partnership with Alliances.
- Track the MSSP-friendly competitive landscape and translate findings into trap questions and differentiation for partner sales teams; partner with Competitive Intelligence to keep MSSP content current and relevant.
- Train partner-facing Sales and Alliances teams on MSSP messaging, packaging, and objection handling.
- Act as the go-to PMM resource for MSSP-related questions from Sales, Alliances, and the partners themselves.
- Partner with Product Marketing leads across product areas to ensure MSSP content reflects current product capabilities and roadmap; flag MSSP-specific messaging gaps or conflicts to the broader PMM team before content ships externally.

### What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 5 or more years in product marketing or partner marketing, with direct experience marketing to or through MSSPs, MSPs, or channel partners in cybersecurity or enterprise software.
- Working knowledge of MSSP business models, including per-endpoint/per-seat pricing, multi-tenant consoles, and co-managed and fully-managed delivery.
- Proven ability to translate platform/product messaging into partner-economics language without losing brand consistency.
- Strong writing and content production skills across decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and case studies.
- Comfort working cross-functionally with Partners, Sales, and Marketing functions.
- Cybersecurity domain knowledge is a strong plus.

### Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

# Senior Digital Marketing Manager

Pavago

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7488086515139320173?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8562713396328618478&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Digital Marketing Manager (B2B Growth, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Location: Pakistan Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale their B2B growth engine.

This is a high-impact, revenue-focused role for someone who understands that marketing is about driving qualified pipeline—not just running campaigns. You'll lead demand generation across paid, organic, and outbound channels while building scalable systems that consistently generate leads, improve conversion rates, and contribute directly to revenue growth.

You'll work closely with leadership and sales to optimize the entire marketing funnel—from awareness to customer acquisition—using data, experimentation, and automation.

If you think in terms of pipeline, CAC, CPL, conversion rates, and revenue, this role is for you.

##### B2B Growth & Demand Generation

- Develop and execute full-funnel B2B marketing strategies that drive qualified pipeline and revenue.
- Build scalable inbound and outbound demand generation programs across multiple channels.
- Increase Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and overall pipeline contribution.
- Optimize lead quality and conversion throughout the customer journey.
- Continuously identify new growth opportunities through testing and experimentation.

##### Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing

- Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across:

 - LinkedIn Ads
 - Google Ads
 - Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)

- Monitor and improve:

 - Cost per Lead (CPL)
 - Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 - Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
 - Conversion Rates

- Conduct ongoing A/B testing of audiences, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
- Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

##### Content, SEO & Organic Growth

- Support SEO strategy through keyword research, content planning, and search intent optimization.
- Improve organic traffic and inbound lead generation.
- Ensure consistent messaging across paid, organic, and outbound marketing channels.
- Optimize landing pages and website content to improve conversion performance.

##### CRM, Marketing Automation & Email Marketing

- Manage marketing operations using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.
- Build and optimize:

 - Lead nurturing workflows
 - Lead scoring models
 - Email automation sequences
 - Marketing automation campaigns

- Improve attribution reporting, campaign visibility, and marketing analytics.

##### Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Sales to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.
- Present campaign performance, pipeline insights, and growth recommendations to leadership.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to execute marketing initiatives.
- Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
- Help scale marketing systems, workflows, and best practices.

##### What Makes You a Great Fit

- You think beyond marketing metrics and focus on business growth.
- You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- You're highly analytical and comfortable making decisions based on performance data.
- You take ownership and continuously optimize for better results.
- You thrive in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
- You understand long B2B sales cycles and revenue attribution.

##### Required Experience & Skills

- 5+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation.
- Proven success driving:

 - Pipeline growth
 - Qualified leads (MQLs & SQLs)
 - Revenue impact

- Hands-on experience with:

 - LinkedIn Ads
 - Google Ads
 - Meta Ads
 - HubSpot or similar CRM platforms

- Experience managing multi-channel demand generation campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign performance and ROI.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

##### Nice to Have

- Experience in SaaS, agency, or service-based businesses.
- Experience with outbound marketing and sales enablement initiatives.
- Previous leadership or team mentoring experience.
- Strong understanding of:

 - B2B attribution
 - Funnel optimization
 - Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
 - Marketing analytics and reporting

##### What Success Looks Like

- Consistent growth in qualified MQLs and SQLs.
- Lower customer acquisition costs and improved marketing ROI.
- Increased marketing contribution to revenue and sales pipeline.
- Higher conversion rates throughout the marketing funnel.
- Scalable marketing systems that support long-term business growth.
- Clear reporting and actionable insights that drive strategic decisions.

##### Interview Process

- Initial Screening
- Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
- Strategy & Growth Discussion
- Client Interview
- Offer & Onboarding

##### What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you'll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you'll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don't overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you'd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

If you're a performance-driven marketer who knows how to build scalable growth systems, optimize every stage of the B2B funnel, and turn marketing into measurable pipeline and revenue, we'd love to hear from you.

# Senior Marketing Operations Manager

Prompt Health

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4525733091933328925?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7414497151328502120&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Marketing Operations Manager

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. We strive to push the boundaries of what a user can expect from healthcare software.

We are looking for a data-driven, systems-oriented Senior Marketing Operations Manager to join our RevOps Team and work closely with go to market Leadership. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in HubSpot, understands how to architect full-funnel marketing-to-sales workflows, and has experience managing a modern martech stack. You should be comfortable owning everything from pipeline infrastructure and reporting to tool integrations and AI-driven optimizations.

This is Prompt's first dedicated operations hire to work primarily in marketing. You're deciding what the system looks like, with a marketing leader and a RevOps team who already know what they want and will get out of your way.

##### Responsibilities

Funnel Performance & Conversion Optimization

- Identify opportunities and leaks within the funnel to drive more demos, increase arrival rate, and accelerate sales cycles and velocity (CRO)
- Report on and analyze results of A/B testing, CRO experiments, and campaign optimizations.

Reporting & Attribution

- Build and maintain attribution reporting to track campaign & event effectiveness, pipeline influence, and ROI across channels and stages of the buyer journey.
- Develop and maintain custom dashboards and reports in HubSpot for marketing KPIs, pipeline attribution, and campaign performance.
- Provide actionable insights and educate teams on how to interpret and apply the data to improve performance and decision making.

Website & Search Performance

- Technical SEO knowledge and AEO support
- Partner with development teams to monitor and maintain Google Search Console and address website crawlability and indexing issues.

Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations

- Partner with creative teams to manage email template builds and ensure email systems in HubSpot are scalable and compliant.
- Build custom workflows and automations in HubSpot to support lead nurturing, sales alerts, lifecycle updates, and campaign triggers.
- Oversee the marketing team's use of Asana, ensuring campaigns are well-tracked and deadlines are met.

CRM Architecture & Data Integrity

- Collaborate with Sales Operations to build and maintain the full lead-to-revenue pipeline in HubSpot
- Contact enrichment, lead quality and scoring, and regular pipeline and overall maintenance of CRM

Martech Stack & Integrations

- Manage integrations across marketing and sales tools including HubSpot, Slack, Walnut, and others to ensure seamless data flow.
- Evaluate and implement new martech, including AI tools, ABM platforms, and website heatmap technology (e.g. Decibel by Medallia).
- Stay up to date with the latest capabilities in HubSpot, analytics platforms, AI, and digital marketing tools to suggest operational improvements.

##### Minimum Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, with hands-on ownership of HubSpot marketing and CRM features.
- You operate AI-first. You've connected LLMs to your stack (Claude MCP, HubSpot AI, or equivalent) and built workflows that run without you for marketing automation, pipeline prediction, and analytics.
- Proven experience managing marketing-to-sales handoff workflows, including lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and campaign attribution.
- Experience supporting both sales-led and product-led growth models, with a strong focus on building marketing reporting infrastructure that measures funnel performance, attribution, and conversion across both motions.
- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrations between marketing, CRM, and enablement platforms.
- Experience creating documentation and playbooks for internal marketing workflows and tools.
- Strong understanding of digital performance metrics, especially across email, paid media, and content channels.
- Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and lead attribution modeling.
- Experience managing marketing campaign projects in Asana or similar tools.
- Excellent analytical, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

##### Certifications in the following are strongly preferred:

- HubSpot Marketing Software Certification (or HubSpot Operations/Reporting certifications)
- Google Analytics Certification (GA4) via Skillshop
- Google Ads Search Certification
- Any AI-related certifications (e.g., from HubSpot AI Academy, Google AI/ML, or similar) are a plus

##### Preferred (nice-to-have) qualifications:

- Familiarity with ABM platforms such as Demandbase, 6sense, or RollWorks.
- Hands-on experience with website behavior tracking tools such as Decibel, Hotjar, or similar.
- Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS for reviewing email and landing page builds.

About Dashlane
Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.
We’re looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane, including how we work, how we hire, and the benefits of being a Dashlaner.
About the Role In this role, you will own the administration, optimization, and integration of our entire MarTech stack, including Marketo, chatbot tools, and Asana. You will collaborate closely with our Analytics team to build automated dashboards and direct our external marketing automation agency to scale execution. The current team requires a leader who can standardize frameworks for campaign execution, eliminate manual bottlenecks, and enable self-service capabilities for global and regional marketers.
At Dashlane you will: Rebuild and own the administration, optimization, and integration of the MarTech stack, including Marketo, Salesforce, chatbot tools, and Asana.
Direct our external marketing automation agency partner to implement infrastructure enhancements, setting clear quality standards and scaling output.
Build and lead end-to-end campaign intake, project management, and execution workflows via Asana.
Leverage AI-powered automation platforms, Zapier, and LLMs across intake, build, QA, and asset creation to expand execution capacity without expanding headcount.

Manage email traffic, resource allocation, and cross-functional coordination to deliver high-quality marketing campaigns on time.

Partner with the Analytics team to build automated dashboards and ROI tracking systems that use advanced tracking to tie performance clearly to business outcomes.
Requirements: 5+ years of experience in Campaign Operations, Marketing Operations, or MarTech.

Expert-level Marketo proficiency, including deep knowledge of instance architecture, tokens, assets, and program hierarchy.
Strong Salesforce knowledge, including CRM sync, campaign hierarchy, UTM standards, and core integrations (such as chatbots, webinars, or ABM tools).
Experience directing and managing deliverables for an external marketing automation agency partner.
Active, day-to-day deployment of AI tools (such as LLMs, Zapier, or automation platforms) to accelerate campaign builds and scale execution.
Professional fluency in English.
We’re Also Looking For: A "diagnose before building" mindset—the ability to systematically analyze root causes of system failures before deploying architectural solutions.
Strong stakeholder influence, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical infrastructure decisions into clear business outcomes for non-technical marketing leaders.
High comfort operating at pace within a fast-growing environment with significant growth expectations.
Excellent operational leadership skills to manage multiple workstreams, cross-functional dependencies, and process changes simultaneously while fostering a culture of operational experimentation.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical‑centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Role
Sword Health is looking for an exceptional go-getter to join our team as a Lifecycle Marketing Operations Specialist to own the execution and deployment of our data-driven marketing initiatives. This role requires an independent self-starter who can flawlessly deliver the baseline but also proactively seeks to improve existing processes to increase efficiency and scalability. A subject‑matter‑expert who can manage, build and execute against requirements from various stakeholders. Collaborating intimately across Growth, Data, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams will be core to success.

Manage day-to-day campaign production, QA, execution, reporting & optimization of marketing campaigns and programs

Own implementation of automated journeys and blast campaigns from start to finish, across multiple channels including email, sms, push, in‑app and direct mail

Work cross-functionally with various teams, including Enrollment, Growth, Member Engagement, Content, Creative, Data, Product & Engineering to launch communications across Sword-owned channels

Ensure that Marketing Operations standards are met, including proper naming conventions, event conversion tagging, and QA prior to campaign deployment

Monitor and optimize multiple campaigns & programs at a time, ensuring that campaigns launch and deliver on schedule and according to expectations

Proactively identify issues leading up to a launch and during a live campaign that would prevent campaign success, working with key stakeholders to solve and troubleshoot as necessary

Code logic in email template to personalize content for 1:1 experience using scripting language such as Handlebars, Liquid, AMPScript, etc.

Lead and own improvements on operational processes to improve efficiency and scalability

Uncover hidden opportunities for the improvement of processes and data. Proactively find blockers and challenges to our growth, then take the initiative to solve them

Collaborate with Growth & Engineering teams to ensure data pipelines are set up between marketing systems for real time data updates, event triggers, and member profile updates prior to campaign launches

Develop and document best practices approach for gathering and analyzing data to identify key performance indicators, prioritization, and optimization strategies

What you need to have

Minimum 2 year experience in Lifecycle/Marketing Operations with at least one marketing automation platform, such as Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Cordial, Marketo, etc. (Iterable a plus, but not necessary)

Experience in building and deploying omni-channel messaging, including email, push, SMS, in-app, direct mail

Knowledge in HTML/CSS with experience in coding mobile-first email templates

Strong understanding of email clients and strengths/limitations of each

Experience with scripting languages

Passionate about understanding the member journey at each stage of their lifecycle and building member journey flows to optimize the member experience

Action-oriented and deadline-driven, with high level of project management and time management skills to prioritize deadlines and requests

Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment with rapidly changing requirements and shifting priorities

Independent, self-starter who can work autonomously and deliver results

An enthusiastic, take‑charge attitude, coupled with a desire to collaborate and learn

Strong communication skills to set expectations and provide progress with stakeholders

Ability to collaborate with multiple teams across multiple time zones

Analytically driven, with ability to gather insights across multiple channels

# Senior Marketing Specialist

$100k - $130k

TalentStack

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3049590723924339174?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2660218963397524818&crId=US_0US_0)

Senior Marketing Specialist – Growth
Location: New York City, hybrid

Working pattern: 2-3 days per week in office

Salary: $100,000-$130,000 base bonus, dependent on experience

Employment: Full time

The Opportunity
We’re working with a growing B2B SaaS business operating within the enterprise LegalTech market as they hire a Senior Marketing Specialist focused on growth.

This is a hands-on performance marketing role responsible for two key growth channels: email marketing and paid acquisition .

You’ll own the execution of campaigns rather than managing agencies or directing others to build them, working closely with Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations.

The focus is firmly on pipeline generation, lead quality and commercial impact , rather than impressions or vanity metrics.

What You’ll Be Doing
Email & Lifecycle Marketing

Own email marketing campaigns end-to-end through HubSpot

Build audience segmentation, personalisation and targeting strategies

Develop and optimise campaign copy alongside the Content team

Manage campaign QA, deployment and reporting

Run structured experiments across subject lines, messaging, CTAs and personalisation

Maintain strong database hygiene and email deliverability

Analyse results and turn campaign learnings into repeatable best practices

Paid Acquisition

Manage paid campaigns across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads

Test additional channels including Reddit, G2 and emerging paid platforms

Build targeting and retargeting audiences alongside Demand Generation

Turn existing content into compelling paid campaign assets

Brief and direct creative assets, including short-form video where required

Launch, monitor and continuously optimise campaigns against performance

Own conversion tracking, bidding strategy and attribution reporting

What We’re Looking For

4 years of hands-on paid acquisition or growth marketing experience

Experience within B2B SaaS or a strong B2B performance marketing agency background

Strong practical knowledge of Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads

Strong HubSpot experience, including segmentation, forms, sequences, smart content and reporting

Demonstrable experience building and optimising both email and paid campaigns

Strong understanding of conversion, pipeline creation and lead quality

Experience working within longer, multi-stakeholder enterprise buying cycles

Comfortable working cross-functionally with RevOps, Product Marketing, Content and Demand Generation

Strong analytical and project management skills

Able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

Comfortable challenging existing approaches and testing new ideas

Experience using AI tools to accelerate creative development, analysis and optimisation

Nice to Have

Experience with Reddit Ads

G2 advertising experience

Experience with emerging AI advertising platforms

Clay experience

The Business
The company is an established and growing enterprise LegalTech SaaS business helping corporate legal teams improve how they manage legal operations, spend, matters and external counsel. Its technology combines AI, workflow automation and data to give in-house legal teams greater visibility and control across their operations.

The business works with major enterprise organisations and offers the pace and ownership associated with a high-growth SaaS environment, alongside the stability of being part of a much larger global software organisation.

This hire will join a collaborative marketing function with significant exposure across the wider commercial organisation and the opportunity to directly influence how the company generates pipeline.

Package & Benefits

$100,000-$130,000 base salary depending on experience

Performance-related bonus

401(k) with company match

Medical, dental and vision coverage

Paid time off

Parental leave

Wellbeing support and stipend

Commuter benefits

Professional development and tuition support

Rocket Travel

About Rocket Travel by AgodaRocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms. We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth. We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers. Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams. Get to know our team: The Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We’re analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, and other teams to shape RTA's growth agenda.The opportunity:We are looking for a dynamic and versatile Senior Marketing Analyst who will focus on marketing guidance and support for our white label travel platform partners. This is a strategic role where you will work closely with our Partner Managers, Product Owners and the larger Marketing team to understand the partners’ needs, advise them on impactful marketing initiatives, and drive the growth of the platform.What you'll do:Marketing Strategy and Execution: Understand the partners’ business models and goals and provide expert advice on the best marketing strategies to achieve growth. Recommend initiatives to optimize campaigns and enhance platform performance for end-users.• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities, delivering actionable insights that inform marketing strategies. Regularly monitor platform performance and recommend optimizations based on data findings.• Influencing Decision-Making: Guide and influence partners to adopt strategies and solutions that align with their goals as well as our business objectives. Serve as an advisor, simplifying complex marketing strategies for non-experts.• Revenue Growth: Strategically focus on maximizing contribution margin and ROI while ensuring partner satisfaction and long-term engagement.• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including sales, product, analytics, and operations, to ensure smooth execution and alignment of initiatives.What you'll need to succeed:5 years of relevant Marketing experienceBachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred.• Proven marketing experience, ideally within e-commerce, travel, or SaaS environments.• Experience in a consultative or advisory role, preferably with a consulting background.• Strong analytical skills with the ability to dissect data and provide actionable recommendations. Basic knowledge of SQL (joins, filters, aggregates) is a must, advanced (window functions, CTEs) is a plus.Exceptional communication, both written – clear, powerful slides – and spoken – ability to handle conversations with stakeholders and motivate them to adopt strategic decisions.• Exposure to sales with an understanding of how partnerships contribute to revenue growth.• Proven track record of leading multi-stakeholder initiatives successfully.At this time, we’re unfortunately unable to provide support for OPT/CPT student visas or H-1B transfers for this role. As a result, preference will be given to candidates who are U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or Green Card holders.There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.The annual salary range for the Chicago-metro area is $110,000-$138,000. Diversity at Rocket Travel by AgodaRocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career. We encourage all applicants looking to expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues to apply to our team. Note on general employment requirementsCandidates should be authorized to accept employment in the US from any employer and must be able to work a hybrid work schedule with 2-3 days per week in the stated physical office (unless otherwise indicated).Equal Opportunity Employer At Rocket Travel by Agoda, we pride ourselves on being companies represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details, please read Rocket Travel by Agoda’s privacy policy. Prequel Solutions is partnering with a company to hire a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist. This hands-on role will connect campaign and customer data to business results, helping marketing leadership understand what is working and where to invest.

Reporting to the Marketing & Brand Manager, you’ll build reporting, guide performance improvements and collaborate with an established team of customer insights analysts. This role has no direct reports.

**Responsibilities**

- Analyze performance across digital advertising, email, direct mail, branch and community marketing.
- Connect data across campaigns, channels and customer segments to assess marketing effectiveness.
- Build Power BI dashboards and reports tracking acquisition costs, conversions, campaign ROI and customer lifetime value.
- Translate findings into clear recommendations on budget allocation, targeting, messaging and channel mix.
- Support customer segmentation, campaign testing, retention and cross-sell analysis.
- Present insights to marketing leadership, executives and finance partners.
- Partner with analysts, IT, agencies and vendors to improve tracking, data accuracy and reporting.

**Qualifications**

- 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, performance measurement or a related data-focused marketing role.
- Hands-on Power BI experience and working knowledge of SQL.
- Demonstrated ability to turn analysis into business recommendations and measurable results.
- Strong communication skills, including presenting findings to non-technical and executive audiences.
- Experience combining data from multiple systems and working collaboratively across teams.
- Banking or financial services experience preferred; strong candidates from other industries will be considered.
- Google Analytics, CRM and marketing automation experience helpful; Klaviyo familiarity is a plus.

**The Opportunity**

Shape the marketing measurement approach, build reporting capabilities and directly influence business decisions in a collaborative environment. Remote work is available within Ohio, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, with quarterly in-person meetings.

# Senior Marketing Specialist, K12

JoVE

[Brooklyn, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/Brooklyn%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3570819210347247425?p=1&pos=0&rgn=32654&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4530709439048824911&crId=US_0US_0)

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role
We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to build the K-12 demand engine in the US. The role is accountable for generating marketing qualified leads, converting them into sales qualified opportunities, and delivering sourced pipeline. K-12 is a new growth segment for JoVE and you'll establish how we reach this market with the scope to grow into ownership of the function as the segment scales.

**Responsibilities:**

Generate and qualify leads for the K-12 segment, moving prospects from initial interest to MQL to SQL, and partner closely with sales on handoff, follow-up, and conversion

Drive awareness and engagement among teachers, curriculum leads, and district administrators through targeted campaigns

Plan and run our presence at education conferences and events — booth logistics, materials, lead capture, and post-event nurture that converts leads into qualified opportunities

Produce and deliver marketing materials for K-12 audiences: campaign assets, collateral, email, web, and social content

Optimize marketing strategy based on funnel performance, audience insight, and market feedback

Monitor campaign impact and ROI — track cost per lead, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and pipeline contribution, and use what you learn to sharpen the next campaign

A Bachelor’s degree

5+ years in a marketing role, ideally in EdTech selling into schools or districts

A track record of generating qualified leads and pipeline, with the numbers to back it up

Hands‑on experience with marketing automation, CRM, and analytics tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, or similar)

Event and conference marketing experience, with a focus on lead capture and conversion

Willingness to travel for conferences and events

Self‑directed, results driven and organized

You can expect competitive compensation.

You will make a direct impact in improving student learning in science education.

Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.

Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Location: Charlotte, NC \| In-office
Employment Type: Full-time

CPI Security, a leader in security, smart home, and business automation, is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing team in Charlotte, NC. In this role, you’ll own the marketing data and analytics ecosystem—from click tracking to lead conversion reporting. You’ll use SQL, GA4, Tableau, Salesforce, Invoca, GTM, and related platforms to build trusted reporting, improve attribution, identify performance trends, and help channel owners make smarter decisions about spend, testing, and strategy.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain SQL-backed datasets for campaign, channel, lead, attribution, and conversion reporting

Analyze marketing performance across paid search, paid social, display, email, web, offline, and other channels

Partner with channel owners to answer key business questions: what happened, why it happened, and what to do next

Standardize marketing KPIs including leads, conversion rates, CPL, CPA, ROI, attribution windows, and funnel metrics

Develop Tableau dashboards and recurring reports based on trusted data models

Monitor data quality, tracking gaps, duplicates, reconciliation issues, and reporting inconsistencies

Support attribution, media mix, lead quality, funnel conversion, and budget allocation analysis

Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, multivariate tests, and marketing experiments

QA and troubleshoot tracking across GA4, GTM, Salesforce, Invoca, paid media platforms, email, web, and offline channels

Present clear, actionable insights to Marketing, Sales, agencies, and leadership

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience as a marketing analyst, marketing data analyst, data analyst, or similar role

Strong SQL skills, including pulling, joining, cleaning, and aggregating marketing and CRM data

Experience supporting digital or performance marketing teams with actionable reporting and analysis

Hands‑on experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager

Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools connected to SQL/data models

2+ years of experience designing and analyzing marketing tests or experiments

Understanding of paid search, paid social, display, email, and omnichannel campaign measurement

Experience with CRM or marketing automation reporting; Salesforce preferred

Strong data‑quality mindset and ability to validate reporting before sharing insights

Clear communication skills with the ability to explain findings to technical and non‑technical audiences

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Economics, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

Nice to Have

Advanced SQL, including CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, or warehouse/ETL experience

Python or R for deeper analysis

Experience with customer lifetime value, predictive scoring, MMM, or multi‑touch attribution

Paid media platform APIs or warehouse integrations

Experience in security, home services, smart home, subscription, or lead‑generation businesses

Experience working with agencies and Sales teams on lead quality and funnel conversion

Why Join CPI Security?
At CPI Security, you’ll join a collaborative, mission‑driven team focused on innovation, service, and protecting what matters most. Your work will directly influence how marketing performance is measured and how teams make decisions that help customers feel safer, more connected, and more in control.

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability options

Paid holidays, floating holidays, and PTO

401(k) with competitive company match

Free monitored security system eligibility after 90 days

Education assistance

Volunteer and community engagement opportunities

On‑site café, coffee/smoothie bar, walking trail, basketball court, and fitness facility with dedicated staff

Right Side Up

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

About Right Side Up Right Side Up is a collective of premium marketing talent – with all the marketing chops and none of the agency fluff. We’re trusted by the most buzzed-about early-stage ventures, the fastest growing tech companies, and well-established Fortune 500 teams to do one thing better: GROWTH. Some of our clients include Parachute Home, Happiest Baby, Nutrafol, Robinhood, Just Food For Dogs, Nourish, The INKEY List, and many others.
What We’re Looking For We are looking for affiliate managers who are passionate about the industry and want to demonstrate their expertise through contract work. As a consultant, you’ll act as a trusted extension of our team, managing clients while maintaining the flexibility of contract work. Our clients typically seek consultant opportunities with availability ranging from 10 to 40 hours per week.
What You’ll Do Own the day-to-day management of client relationships, providing proactive communication, documentation, guidance, and expertise to client stakeholders.
Develop and execute full-funnel affiliate strategies that align with our client’s goals.
Provide full-service, end-to-end program management, from strategic execution and optimization to program operations.
Source, recruit, and activate high-value partners that drive incremental growth across the full funnel.
Collaborate with and optimize existing partners to increase exposure and drive incremental growth.
Effectively manage the client's channel and media budget, with a focus on driving efficiencies and a strong ROI.
Provide performance reporting on a regular cadence, highlighting wins, challenges, and new opportunities.
Manage program operations including commission terms, partner compliance and to ensure partner compliance, commission terms, effective commissioning strategies.
What You’ll Bring 5+ years of hands-on experience managing affiliate programs with proven success in accelerating customer acquisition through a wide array of partnerships.
Deep understanding of affiliate marketing and eagerness to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the changes in the industry.
Demonstrated understanding of how AI is shaping affiliate management, including its impact on recruitment, attribution, and optimization strategies.
Ability to leverage non-traditional partnerships to drive new customer acquisition.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to leadership, documenting, and putting together reports that illustrate program performance and growth opportunities.
An analytical approach to performance marketing and decision-making, weaving in data where there is an opportunity.
Ability to balance strategic thinking and execution; able to shift from big picture thinking to tactical on a dime.
Relationship mindset and a constant pursuit to grow your network of partnerships.
Experience in some of our core verticals, such as Retail, Health & Wellness, CPG, B2SMB/Prosumer, FinTech, Subscription & Services.
Bonus Experience Experience developing strategy and managing traditional influencer programs and relationships.
Managing Amazon and TikTok Affiliate programs.
Background in other marketing channels and a solid understanding of how they can work together to fuel growth.

AMD

[Santa Clara, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Santa-Clara%2C-CA)

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.THE ROLE:Join AMD’s Enterprise Ecosystem & Partner Marketing team and play a pivotal role in establishing AMD as a premier innovation partner in the enterprise market through deep, strategic collaboration with AWS. Our team works across hyperscalers, cloud service providers, GPU cloud platforms, and AI infrastructure innovators to amplify AMD’s influence, strengthen brand affinity, and accelerate enterprise adoption at scale.As a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you will develop and execute high-impact partner marketing strategies that showcase AMD’s value across cloud and neo-cloud ecosystems, spanning compute, AI accelerators, and data center platforms. You will drive joint positioning, solution storytelling, and demand-generation programs that help enterprise customers adopt AMD-powered instances, services, and validated solutions.Your work will blend strategic narrative, partner go-to-market execution, and thought leadership to create compelling value propositions for technical and business decision-makers. You will collaborate across business development, product marketing, cloud alliances, events, public relations, and sales to build integrated campaigns that expand AMD’s presence across partner channels, including cloud marketplaces, partner solution catalogs, developer communities, and partner-led events.THE PERSON:You are a strategic and creative partner marketer who thrives at the intersection of cloud innovation, ecosystem partnerships, and go-to-market execution. You excel at building trusted relationships with cloud providers and technology partners while translating complex technical capabilities into compelling customer-facing narratives.You are highly collaborative, comfortable influencing across organizations, and energized by developing programs that drive measurable business impact. You bring strong communication, project management, and storytelling skills, coupled with a results-oriented mindset and a passion for advancing AMD’s leadership across the cloud and AI ecosystem. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:Build Cloud Partner Relationships & Joint Plans – Develop strong marketing relationships with AWS, understand partner priorities, and translate shared business objectives into actionable joint marketing plans.Influence MDF & Partner Activation – Identify opportunities to secure and influence partner MDF, marketing resources, channels, and amplification around AMD’s priority workloads, solutions, and customer opportunitiesLead Comarketing Campaigns & Demand with Partner – Develop and execute integrated co-marketing programs across digital, events, webinars, content, account-based marketing, and partner-led channels to drive awareness, engagement, demand, and pipeline growth.Work with partners to expand AMD presence and visibility across channels – Improve AMD visibility and conversion across AWS marketplaces, partner solution pages, and developer ecosystems through strong messaging, assets, and merchandising.Turn Proof & Partner Moments into Demand – Scale customer wins, benchmarks, technical validation, and partner proof through campaigns and activate AMD offers at moments such as AWS reinvent, roadshows, executive forums, and customer experiences to engage priority accounts and create demand.Drive Execution & Measure Impact – Partner closely with AMD product marketing, sales, business development, alliances, public relations, and AWS stakeholders to execute programs, measure performance, optimize return on investment on MDF, and ensure successful and timely delivery of joint initiatives.Enable Partner & Field Readiness – Create enablement assets, toolkits, playbooks, and sales materials that help AMD and partner teams articulate differentiated value propositions and drive customer adoption. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:B2B marketing experience within a technology company, cloud platform, neo-cloud provider, systems company, or enterprise SaaS or PaaS organization.Demonstrated experience with cloud alliances and joint go-to-market strategies, including co-marketing models, market development funds, account-based marketing, and partner communications.Experience building relationships and working with senior stakeholders across cloud alliances, product marketing, sales, and business development.Ability to translate platform roadmaps and complex cloud, AI, compute, or data center capabilities into clear partner narratives, differentiated solution positioning, and launch-ready messaging.Experience defining and analyzing partner program effectiveness and optimizing campaigns, content, enablement, and investments for measurable pipeline and business impact.Experience developing co-branded content, digital demand-generation programs, and sales or technical enablement materials.Familiarity with cloud marketplaces and partner solution listings, including marketplace page optimization, partner solution catalogs, and campaign-in-a-box execution.Exceptional storytelling, messaging, and content-development skills that position AMD and cloud ecosystem partners as trusted enterprise leaders.Highly organized, proactive, and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and partner initiatives in a global environment.Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous-improvement mindset focused on increasing marketing impact, partner engagement, and return on investment.ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.Relevant cloud, digital marketing, partner marketing, or demand-generation certifications are desired.LOCATION:Austin, Texas; # Senior Partner Marketing Manager

Teleport Inc

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1256872254404534657?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5350082939702962775&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Teleport**

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

**About the Role**

As Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you'll own the strategy and execution of Teleport's partner marketing programs - building the co-marketing campaigns, partner enablement materials, and joint events that drive pipeline through our channel, cloud, and technology alliances. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Marketing and our Channel and Alliance teams, ensuring partner messaging ladders into Teleport's core narrative and that every marketing dollar spent in the ecosystem is tied to measurable pipeline impact. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution, and who knows how to turn partner relationships into revenue.

**What You Will Do**

- **Enable the Ecosystem:** Create "To-Partner" toolkits, playbooks, and sales enablement materials that empower partner sales teams to effectively pitch Teleport to their customers.
- **Strategic Sales Alignment:** Serve as the marketing lead for our Channel and Alliance managers, aligning marketing spend with territory goals to accelerate late-stage deals through partner influence.
- **Design & Execute Co-Marketing Programs:** Lead the strategy and execution of "With-Partner" marketing campaigns, including joint webinars, co-branded content, and digital demand generation designed to drive pipeline for both Teleport and our partners.
- **Strategize and Execute Partner Events:** Identify and execute partner events and activations. This includes securing speaking slots in partner theaters, organizing high-touch networking events, and managing joint sponsorships.
- **Campaign Integration:** Collaborate with the Global Campaigns and Product Marketing teams to ensure partner messaging is woven into our core narrative, specifically targeting the "Developer to Decision-Maker" journey.
- **Lifecycle Partner Marketing:** Collaborate on the end-to-end partner journey, from onboarding new technology partners to optimizing long-term co-marketing ROI.
- **Measurement & Optimization:** Track, analyze, and report on the impact of partner programs. You will own the metrics for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, iterating on tactics based on data-driven insights.

**What We're Looking For**

- **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in partner marketing within the B2B SaaS space.
- **Ecosystem Knowledge:** Proven track record of working with channel partners/resellers and major cloud providers like (AWS, GCP, Azure) or security/infrastructure technology partners.
- **Background:** In cybersecurity and knowledge of industry.
- **The "Tradeshow" Mindset:** You understand that events are about density and trust. You have experience managing logistics and high-stakes networking environments.
- **Project Management:** Exceptional ability to manage multiple stakeholders (internal and external) and meet deadlines.
- **Tech Stack:** Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce and marketing automation (HubSpot/Marketo). Experience with PRM (Partner Relationship Management) tools is a plus.
- **Communication:** You can translate deep technical concepts into value-driven stories for both business and technical audiences.
- **Travel:** Willingness to travel (up to 30%) to key partner hubs and major industry events.

**How We Hire**

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

You'll start with a 30-minute recruiter screen, followed by another 30-minute interview with the hiring manager. Then we'll have you meet with other members of the marketing and sales organizations for 30-minutes each, and a final 30-minute round with our CMO.

**Why Teleport**

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

**The Benefits**

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be - giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

\- Extensive health coverage

\- Annual expense budget

\- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

\- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

\- Professional development opportunities

# Senior Technical Partner Marketing Manager New San Jose, California, United States

SambaNova, Inc.

[San Jose, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Jose%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2425923909234691546?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7561&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5380811855509545418&crId=US_0US_0)

### Available Positions

SambaNova employs some of the greatest minds and talent in AI and machine learning. If you'd like to help lead the next generation of AI computing, we want to hear from you.

### Senior Technical Partner Marketing Manager

San Jose, California, United States

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) - a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is hiring a Senior Technical Partner Marketing Manager to turn relationships across the ML and AI ecosystem into differentiated joint solutions, clear “better together” stories, and repeatable go-to-market programs. This role will work across model-serving and open-source frameworks, silicon and infrastructure, cloud and inference platforms, model providers, developer tools, and AI application platforms to show how combined technologies create greater value for developers and enterprise customers.

### About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of Partner Engineering, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Alliances, Product, and go-to-market. You will identify the strongest joint value propositions by ecosystem segment, translate integrations and shared roadmaps into credible technical stories, and bring those stories to market through reference architectures, demos, launches, content, and field programs. The right candidate can go deep enough on an integration to define why it matters, align independent organizations around a shared narrative, and build a coordinated GTM motion that creates adoption and business value for both sides.

### Responsibilities

- Develop segment-specific partner strategies across model-serving and open-source frameworks, silicon and accelerators, cloud and inference providers, model providers, data and developer platforms, AI tooling, and application ecosystems
- Define differentiated “better together” value propositions that explain the customer and developer outcomes created by each class of integration
- Turn partner integrations into reference architectures, validated demos, solution briefs, tutorials, benchmarks, presentations, and field enablement
- Build and execute joint go-to-market plans with clear audiences, use cases, messaging, assets, launch sequences, field motions, and measures of success
- Partner closely with Alliances, Engineering, Product, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Sales, and partner teams to define shared priorities, responsibilities, and deliverables
- Lead the content and readiness workstream for partner launches, ensuring technical claims, demonstrations, and proof points are accurate and reviewable
- Create reusable segment playbooks that help SambaNova evaluate opportunities and scale successful partner motions across the ML and AI ecosystem
- Support technical workshops, partner briefings, field meetings, campaigns, events, webinars, and executive engagements with tailored demos and clear talk tracks
- Gather ecosystem feedback and competitive insight to inform product priorities, integration strategy, positioning, and future partner investments
- Track developer adoption, co-marketing performance, influenced pipeline, asset usage, partner engagement, and customer outcomes; use results to improve the GTM strategy

### What We’re Looking For

- 7+ years of experience in partner marketing, technical product marketing, developer marketing, solutions architecture, strategic alliances, or a closely related role
- Technical fluency in AI infrastructure, model serving, inference, open-source software, cloud platforms, silicon, developer tools, or data center systems
- Experience building joint value propositions and executing coordinated go-to-market programs with technology partners
- Ability to understand an integration deeply enough to create credible technical content, demonstrations, positioning, and enablement
- Strong program management and stakeholder leadership across internal teams and independent partner organizations
- Excellent writing, presentation, and verbal communication skills for developer, partner, field, and enterprise audiences
- High ownership, sound judgment, and comfort independently balancing technical accuracy, partner priorities, and launch timelines

### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working across multiple ML and AI ecosystem segments, such as model-serving frameworks, silicon, cloud infrastructure, model platforms, developer tools, or AI applications
- Hands-on familiarity with reference architectures, proofs of concept, benchmarking, workload optimization, integration testing, or OpenAI-compatible APIs
- Experience supporting joint launches, executive events, developer programs, customer proof, and partner or sales enablement
- A track record of turning a technical integration into measurable adoption, engagement, influenced pipeline, or customer value

- Experience creating repeatable partner playbooks or scaling a successful joint GTM motion across a broader ecosystem segment

### Why This Role Matters

AI adoption depends on an ecosystem, not a single component. This role will define where SambaNova fits across the ML and AI value chain, make each integration’s combined value easy to understand, and turn strong technical partnerships into coordinated go-to-market motions that benefit developers, customers, and partners.

Epson is a global technology leader whose philosophy of efficient, compact and precise innovation enriches lives and helps create a better world. The Senior Specialist, Content Marketing is responsible for the strategic planning, management, and creation of content leveraged throughout Epson’s marketing efforts. This role partners across the organization to deliver compelling content that supports business priorities, strengthens brand authority, and engages target audiences.

This is a remote position and you must be currently located within the continguous United States.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

**Content Strategy & Thought Leadership**

- Lead the development, production, management, and distribution of high-quality thought leadership and content marketing programs across Epson’s U.S. lines of business, translating business priorities, customer insights, and market trends into compelling content.
- Partner cross-functionally with business units, product marketing, communications, digital, social, demand generation, sales, agencies, and subject-matter experts to develop an integrated content strategy and editorial roadmap aligned with business and audience objectives.
- Operate with a brand publisher mindset, identifying the topics, questions, trends, and insights most valuable to Epson audiences and developing content that builds authority, drives engagement, supports demand generation, and creates clear paths to conversion.
- Develop and maintain editorial standards and governance that ensure content consistently reflects Epson’s brand voice, positioning, style, quality standards, and business objectives.

**Editorial, Search & AI Optimization**

- Apply best practices in SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), AI search optimization, content architecture, and structured content to improve the visibility and discoverability of Epson content across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery experiences.
- Understand how search behavior and content discovery are evolving through generative AI, answer engines, and large language models, and translate those developments into practical content strategies.
- Create and optimize content for authority, relevance, clarity, citation-worthiness, and reuse, helping Epson become a trusted source for customers, industry influencers, search engines, and AI-powered platforms.
- Use audience insights, search data, competitive intelligence, and performance analytics to identify content opportunities, gaps, and emerging topics across Epson’s businesses.

**Project & Production Management**

- Own complex content projects from concept through publication and measurement, establishing objectives, scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, stakeholder responsibilities, and approval processes.
- Develop and manage an integrated editorial calendar spanning multiple businesses, campaigns, audiences, formats, and distribution channels.
- Coordinate internal stakeholders, subject-matter experts, writers, designers, agencies, and other creative resources to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to established quality standards.
- Proactively identify project risks, competing priorities, resource constraints, and dependencies; communicate status clearly and drive decisions needed to keep work moving.
- Establish scalable workflows, templates, processes, and governance that improve content production efficiency and enable greater reuse of content across channels and business units.

**Technology & AI-Enabled Content Operations**

- Evaluate, adopt, and apply emerging technologies to improve content research, planning, development, optimization, repurposing, distribution, and measurement.
- Develop responsible and repeatable approaches for using AI tools while maintaining editorial judgment, factual accuracy, originality, intellectual property safeguards, brand standards, and appropriate human review.
- Maintain curiosity about emerging marketing technologies and rapidly develop proficiency with new platforms, tools, and capabilities relevant to content marketing.

**Distribution, Measurement & Optimization**

- Own and evolve Epson’s branded blog and related content experiences, supporting distribution through email/newsletters, social media, lead nurture, campaigns, and other owned and earned channels.
- Understand social media and digital-channel best practices and adapt content formats, messaging, and distribution strategies based on audience and platform behavior.
- Use performance data to continually optimize existing content and inform future editorial priorities, rather than treating publication as the end of the content lifecycle.

**Leadership & Business Management**

- Manage external creative resources, including writers, designers, agencies, and specialized content partners, ensuring quality, efficiency, and alignment with Epson objectives.
- Build productive relationships with executives and subject-matter experts and help translate their expertise into distinctive, credible thought leadership.
- Develop and deliver executive-level presentations communicating content strategy, program priorities, performance, insights, and recommendations.
- Manage budgets associated with content marketing programs and external resources, identifying opportunities to maximize impact and operational efficiency.

**What You Will Bring:**

- Five to eight years+ of experience in content marketing, editorial strategy, marketing communications, or a related field.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated success developing integrated content strategies and translating complex business or technical topics into compelling, audience-focused content
- Strong writing, editing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to develop credible thought leadership and communicate effectively with senior leaders and diverse audiences
- Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities, editorial calendars, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and external creative resources.
- Knowledge of search optimization, evolving AI-enabled discovery practices, content architecture, and digital distribution strategies
- Experience using audience insights, market intelligence, and performance analytics to identify opportunities, evaluate results, and optimize content programs

**Employee Benefits**

In addition to joining a team of dedicated professionals who support each other and are passionate about their work, you’ll also enjoy a variety of attractive, industry-leading benefits.

- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage eligibility on start date
- Generous paid time off, including sick time, vacation, and holidays
- Income protection plans, including life insurance and short-term and long-term disability programs paid by the company
- 401K plan with company matching
- Educational reimbursement, employee assistant program (EAP), adoption assistance, employee discounts and much more!

The starting annual base pay for this role is between USD $93,854 and $117,318. Please note that this position’s salary range may include multiple levels. The actual base is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

# Digital Marketing Director

Full-time

NPG Health

[Morristown, NJ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Morristown%2C-NJ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7883201496853473479?p=1&pos=0&rgn=30657&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5344799751524681611&crId=US_0US_0)

NPG Health, a family of healthcare marketing agencies including Pryme and NaviSync, is seeking a **Director of Omnichannel Strategy & Engagement** with 8–10+ years of experience in omnichannel strategy, digital marketing, or customer engagement, ideally within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry. This senior, client-facing leader will translate brand objectives and audience insights into connected engagement strategies across HCP and patient audiences, channels, content, and experiences. The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, digital fluency, and commercial acumen with the ability to turn data into measurable business and brand outcomes.

This role requires a strategic leader who can connect creative, media, technology, content, CRM, social, and analytics into cohesive customer engagement programs. The Director will use audience research, social listening, segmentation, journey mapping, and performance data to shape channel strategies, content ecosystems, influencer programs, and activation plans. Success requires the ability to define strategic direction, guide cross-functional execution, and continually optimize engagement based on audience behavior and business results.

In addition to providing hands-on strategic leadership, the Director of Omnichannel Strategy & Engagement will manage and mentor team members; serve as a trusted advisor to clients and senior stakeholders; and partner closely with brand, account, media, analytics, technology, content, and creative leaders.

**ResponsibilitiesDigital Strategy Development:** Own the end-to-end omnichannel strategy for assigned brands, translating business objectives, brand strategy, and audience needs into customer journeys, audience and segmentation strategies, channel roles, content sequencing, personalization opportunities, experience flows, and annual activation roadmaps across HCP and patient audiences.

**Media Strategy and Integration:** Guide the role of paid media within the broader omnichannel ecosystem, partnering with media leaders on audience strategy, channel mix, investment priorities, activation, testing, and optimization. Ensure media plans align with customer journeys, brand objectives, regulatory requirements, KPIs, and ROI expectations.

**Analytics and Tracking Management:** Lead the analytics and measurement function, working closely with the team on establishing measurement frameworks, KPI hierarchies, data and tagging requirements, dashboard strategies, testing plans, and reporting standards.

**Social Media and Community Management:** Set the strategic direction for organic social and community engagement, leveraging social listening and audience insights to inform content strategy, influencer partnerships, and ongoing brand conversations.

**Leadership and Team Development:**

- Lead, mentor, and develop digital team members (Media, Social, CRM, Analytics), providing strategic guidance, performance feedback, and career development support.
- Set clear expectations and ensure high quality, on time delivery across multiple workstreams.
- Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented team culture.

**Requirements and skills**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, a related field, and/or equivalent work experience.
- Minimum of 8-10+ years of experience in digital marketing within the pharmaceutical sector.
- Proven experience leading digital strategy and managing team members or cross functional workstreams.
- Comfortability with presenting and workshopping with clients as well as internal teams.
- Proven ability to design connected omnichannel experiences using audience segmentation, journey mapping, channel orchestration, content sequencing, personalization, and clear conversion pathways.
- Strong working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, content management, social listening, paid media, web analytics, data visualization, customer data, and personalization platforms; familiarity with AI-enabled marketing and next-best-action approaches is preferred.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
- Working knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical marketing regulations and industry standards, including medical-legal-regulatory review, fair balance, privacy and consent considerations, accessibility, and responsible use of customer and patient data.

NPG Health is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
