# Digital Marketing Director

$90k - $110k

Element-360

[Madison, WI](https://jooble.org/jobs/Madison%2C-WI)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3777761887950548419?p=1&pos=0&rgn=52927&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2596067433100474925&crId=US_0US_0)

Marketing Director

Element-360 \| Fully remote within the United States \| Full-time, salaried

$90,000–$110,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonus opportunities and benefits.

About Element-360

Element-360 is a data science-driven digital marketing firm specializing in luxury residential real estate. Our long-standing client relationships include developers of Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, Auberge, Aman, Montage, and Pendry branded residences, alongside boutique developments. Our experience spans 19 countries, supporting more than $20 billion in residential real estate sales.

We combine strategy, digital advertising, CRM, analytics, and AI to help our clients understand demand and connect with qualified buyers. Our approach is collaborative and grounded in data, with an emphasis on thoughtful execution, measurable results, and lasting client relationships.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced marketing professional ready to take ownership of client relationships and marketing delivery. Account management is the primary focus, followed by hands-on Facebook and Instagram advertising. This is an opportunity for a successful marketing manager or agency account leader to step into a director role with an established small but powerful team.

You will directly manage approximately 10 client accounts and provide oversight across a portfolio of approximately 30 total accounts, drawing on team support for questions, analysis, and optimization. You will direct project priorities, assignments, and deadlines. This role does not include direct reports or personnel management.

Responsibilities

Own client communication. Serve as the primary contact for your accounts. Ideally, respond to requests the same business day or by the next business day, looping in others as needed. When an answer requires more time, acknowledge receipt, explain when the client can expect a response, and follow through.

Keep work moving. Anticipate needs, plan ahead, and translate client requests and business goals into clear team priorities, owners, and deadlines. Track progress, resolve dependencies, and flag risks early enough to address them.

Lead performance conversations. Present monthly performance results to key clients using reports and analysis prepared by our reporting specialist. Understand the findings before each meeting, explain performance and next steps, and coordinate answers and follow-up actions with the team.

Execute Meta advertising. Create, launch, and optimize Facebook and Instagram ads. Build and refine audiences using available interest, behavior, and custom-audience options appropriate to the campaign and applicable housing advertising policies.

Manage CRM workflows, copy, and budgets. Maintain and improve HubSpot workflows, navigate Salesforce, write and refine client marketing copy, and manage campaign budgets and spending. Much of this work is already established; updates and new implementation occur as client needs arise.

Coordinate specialist work and support growth. Delegate other execution to the appropriate team members and ensure delivery. Occasionally contribute to pitches, proposals, and opportunities to expand services for existing clients.

Required Qualifications

At least five years of relevant marketing experience, including at least two years independently managing client accounts and executing Meta advertising campaigns.

Experience in all three areas: luxury marketing, real estate marketing, and at a marketing or advertising agency. These experiences may overlap within the same role.

Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, present results clearly, discuss recommendations, and follow through on commitments.

Strong hands-on Meta Ads Manager skills, including ad creation, campaign setup, audience targeting, budget management, and optimization beyond boosted posts.

Practical experience building or maintaining HubSpot workflows and the ability to navigate Salesforce.

Strong copywriting skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment in managing marketing budgets.

Ability to prioritize independently, explain the business value of proposed work, and coordinate team delivery across multiple client accounts.

A bachelor’s degree.

Legal authorization to work in the United States and residence within the United States.

Willingness to travel approximately 2-3 times per year by plane or car.

Experience that will set you apart

• Knowledge of real estate advertising regulations and Meta housing advertising policies.

• Experience identifying and testing effective, policy-compliant audiences for luxury real estate campaigns.

• Meta, HubSpot, or Google Analytics certifications.

Compensation and benefits

• Base salary of $90,000–$110,000, depending on experience.

• Bonus opportunities based on individual and company performance.

• Health insurance and a 401(k) with company matching.

• Two weeks of paid vacation plus 10 paid holidays.

How we work

This is a full-time, salaried position with flexibility in how you organize your workday. You are expected to remain reliably available for scheduled client and team commitments and to meet agreed deadlines. Occasional work outside typical business hours may be balanced with schedule adjustments, such as starting later the following day. Success means clients know what to expect, the team understands what matters most, and work progresses without repeated reminders.

# Head of Digital Marketing Neuberger Job listing

Financialnarrative

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5951836703390746945?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=317803203281022136&crId=US_0US_0)

The Head of Digital Marketing will lead Neuberger's digital marketing strategy with responsibility for the corporate website ecosystem, email marketing program, UX/UI standards, and SEO/GEO. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this leader will manage a team of digital contributors across digital operations, UI/UX design, email build, and website campaigns, partnering closely with Head of Client Coverage Technology. The role has a number of key responsibilities as detailed further below, all of which are being impacted by the evolution of LLMs and AI tools, and thus where leadership on this topic will be key to success.

### Key Responsibilities

### Digital Strategy

Define and own the firm's digital marketing strategy: establish the vision, roadmap, and annual priorities across the website, email, and all external client-facing digital touchpoints. Drive the continuous optimization of the digital estate, ensuring all external client-facing digital touchpoints are cohesive and aligned, with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes across institutional, intermediary, private wealth and LLM audiences. Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI use in marketing.

### Website Implementation & Oversight

Serve as the marketing “owner” of the corporate website, in close partnership with Client Coverage Technology, leading on: content architecture, feature prioritization, and oversight/governance of sprint/release planning, taxonomy, metadata, ADA/WCAG compliance, and QA protocols. Drive the integration of the firm’s services and investment strategies into the website experience.

### Growth Marketing & Optimization

Develop and execute growth marketing tactics including: landing page optimization, CRO, A/B and multivariate testing, personalization. Manage a continuous experimentation program benchmarked year-over-year against defined performance targets. Deploy AI-driven personalization engines and LLM-assisted content recommendation systems to deliver tailored digital experiences across audience segments.

### SEO & GEO

Develop and execute a search strategy spanning SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Lead technical SEO initiatives including site architecture, schema markup, structured data, and Core Web Vitals. Pioneer the firm's GEO practice to maximize discoverability across AI-powered platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

### UX/UI

Oversee and uphold UX/UI standards across all digital properties: Lead the UI/UX team in user research, journey mapping, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. Maintain a scalable digital design system in coordination with the creative studio. Integrate AI-powered UX tools (e.g., session intelligence, heatmap AI, predictive UX modeling) to inform design decisions and improve digital experience outcomes.

### Email Marketing

Oversee the email marketing system including: strategy, template build, deliverability, and performance analysis; A/B testing, personalization, and governance standards; brand compliance, accessibility, and CAN-SPAM/GDPR adherence.

### Analytics & Reporting

Own website analytics and reporting infrastructure via Adobe Analytics, Sitecore, and Tableau: Track website KPIs including traffic, engagement, conversion, SEO/GEO metrics, and content effectiveness. Translate data into roadmap prioritization, UX improvements, and resource decisions.

### Qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive digital marketing and website management experience
- Minimum 5+ years in financial services digital marketing — asset management, wealth management, or capital markets preferred
- Demonstrated experience working with AI/LLM tools in a marketing context (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper, Persado, or similar platforms)
- Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI content governance, and responsible use frameworks
- Key Applications: Sitecore, Azure, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Crazy Egg, SEO/GEO tools (Google Search Console), Figma, Litmus/Salesforce, TransPerfect, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI personalization platforms (e.g., Persado, Movable Ink)

# VP, Brand Marketing (Boys)

MGA Entertainment

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8684248328639945287?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5253282749189685710&crId=US_0US_0)

MGA Entertainment is seeking a visionary and strategic Vice President of Brand Marketing to lead our high-performing Marketing Department. The ideal candidate will drive innovative marketing strategies, enhance brand equity, and contribute significantly to the company’s growth objectives. This senior leadership role requires a proven track record of success in brand marketing, exceptional leadership skills, and the ability to navigate a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

### Key Responsibilities:

### Strategic Leadership and Vision:

- Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategic plans in collaboration with the Company Executive Committee.
- Create consumer-targeted marketing strategies for key products within the MGA portfolio, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy, targets, and budget.
- Lead the development and execution of US & Global brand strategies to drive brand equity, growth, profitability, and market share on a global scale.
- Analyze market trends to identify emerging opportunities and build brand equity.
- Contextualize business plans with future entertainment and category trends (e.g., planning marketing around new movie releases).

### Integrated Marketing Campaigns:

- Oversee the planning and execution of 360 marketing campaigns to achieve financial goals.
- Ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across all channels and regions through global marketing campaigns.
- Define, execute, and maintain the brand voice, values, and tone across all touchpoints.
- Drive innovation in marketing strategies and tactics to keep the brand relevant and engaging for consumers.

### Licensing and Strategic Partnerships:

- Collaborate with licensing partners to generate consumer demand and revenue.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners, including licensors, collaborators, content developers, and retailers.
- Manage forecasts and deliver P&L for licensed products.
- Ensure licensed products are well-placed and promoted at retail.
- Represent the brand at industry events, trade shows, and other public forums to enhance brand visibility and reputation.

### Market Research and Analysis:

- Direct market research and competitor analysis to inform strategic decisions.
- Establish ongoing product research to stay attuned to changing consumer, marketplace, and retailer needs.
- Evaluate POS data in response to advertising/promotional support in conjunction with the sales force.
- Regularly communicate sales and product research findings to relevant departments.
- Provide creative input and support to the Web Development department.

### Cross-Functional Collaboration:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, sales, digital marketing, and regional marketing teams, to ensure cohesive and integrated brand strategies.
- Monitor market trends, consumer insights, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and threats, and adjust strategies accordingly.

### Team Leadership:

- Lead the global brand marketing team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and support to ensure high performance and professional growth across a passionate team.

### Budget Management:

- Manage the global brand marketing budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and maximizing ROI.

### Advertising, PR, Media & Commercials:

- Develop and manage effective advertising and promotion plans and budgets for each brand.
- Work with commercial production teams and external agencies to create target-focused advertising.
- Collaborate with the media buying team to plan and purchase advertising media.
- Ensure all communications and plans align with MGA’s brand image.

### Packaging and Product Development:

- Ensure packaging stands out at retail and maintains brand consistency.
- Work with the Product Development department to develop visually impactful materials within brand guidelines.
- Ensure product instructions are concise and user-friendly.

### New Product Introduction:

- Lead cross-functional teams to manage the introduction of new products from concept to market launch.
- Develop go-to-market strategies and oversee marketing campaigns for new product introductions.
- Coordinate with Product Development, Sales, and Supply Chain teams for successful product launches.
- Monitor and analyze the performance of new products post-launch and adjust marketing strategies as necessary to ensure continued success.

### Trade Shows:

- Manage and execute trade shows effectively within budget constraints.

### Position Requirements:

- Minimum bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred).
- Minimum twelve years of experience in the consumer product industry, with a strong focus on toys and consumer electronics.
- Proven experience in Research & Product Development (R&D) and successful new product launches.
- Extensive experience in media/commercial advertising and communication.
- Strong leadership and management skills, with a track record of leading high-performing teams.
- Creative and innovative thinker with an entrepreneurial spirit.
- Excellent organizational and project management skills.
- Proficiency in computer applications relevant to marketing and data analysis.
- Extensive P&L management experience.
- Strong public relations skills.
- Ability to analyze and implement effective media plans.

### Salary:

$200,000.00 - $250,000.00 /year

# VP of Digital Marketing

Cosmos Corporation

[Saint Louis, MO](https://jooble.org/jobs/Saint-Louis%2C-MO)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7834883281579003451?p=1&pos=0&rgn=1639&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5997247185208875797&crId=US_0US_0)

Reports to: Guy Medaris, SVP Sales, Marketing & New Product Development

Location: Hybrid - St. Louis metro (St. Peters, MO). Must be open to monthly travel to STL or relocation.

Team: Online Retail, DTC, Creative, and Social

## ABOUT COSMOS

At Cosmos Corporation, we make health and wellness products that help people and pets live better lives. From our St. Peters, Missouri headquarters, we manufacture high-quality, natural liquid products with ingredients people trust! As a mid-tier, vertically integrated CPG leader with substantial brand equity, we leverage meaningful working media and dedicated resources across upper-funnel and retail channels to support real digital growth.

## THE OPPORTUNITY

Cosmos has built strong physical availability, category captaincy, and leading share across our top CPG categories. Our digital ecosystem (paid media, retail media, creative, social, and DTC) is active and revenue-generating. We are bringing these channels under one senior executive with full digital P&L ownership to unify strategy, drive cross-funnel tradeoffs, and scale the digital business.

As a mid-tier pet CPG company that is past proof of concept but short of fully built, this role offers real executive latitude and funded working media without corporate bloat, providing high ownership and hands-on operational scope rather than a massive pre-built team.

You will lead an established core team covering Online Retail and Creative while shaping and hiring leadership across DTC and Social. Our reporting infrastructure is powered by Microsoft Fabric and Power BI with integrated AI tools for real-time analytics. On the DTC side, we operate as a Shopify house, keeping additional technology stack decisions open to new leadership.

## WHAT YOU OWN

Digital P&L: Direct accountability for revenue, margin, and total performance marketing spend.

Full-Funnel Media Strategy: End-to-end execution from upper-funnel brand engagement to conversion-driven retail media.

DTC Operations: Complete oversight of our owned site, including merchandising, subscription, CRO, lifecycle, and tech roadmap.

Online Retail Accounts: Channel growth, availability, and brand discipline across Amazon (run as 3P seller), Chewy, Walmart.com, and omni-channel partners.

Digital Brand Presence: Partnering with Portfolio & Brand leadership to guide digital brand presentation and creative direction.

Agency Management: Selective agency partnership and rigorous resource allocation across digital programs.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Working closely with brick-and-mortar and retail account teams to ensure unified market strategy.

Experience managing Amazon in-house as a 3P seller

## QUALIFICATIONS

Experience scaling a mid to growth stage CPG ecommerce brand in the beauty, apparel, lifestyle, baby/parenting, or pet industry

Performance Marketing Ownership: Proven experience managing performance budgets tied directly to revenue and margin outcomes.

E-Commerce Operations: Direct operational leadership across DTC platforms, marketplaces, or omni-retail channels.

Funnel Economics Fluency: Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, contribution margin, and incrementality models.

Talent Development: Track record of recruiting, building, and developing high-performing teams.

Strategic Vision: Ability to synthesize complex channel data into high-level business strategy.

Hands-on experience with retail media platforms across Amazon, Chewy, or Walmart Connect.

## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 90 Days: Deep mastery of our funnel economics (CAC, contribution margin, incrementality by channel) and strong cross-functional relationships with brick-and-mortar retail teams.

First Year: An integrated digital plan backed by a trusted measurement model, key DTC and Social seats filled, and clear digital contribution to category share growth across Grooming, Dental, and Flea & Tick on Amazon, Chewy, and Walmart.

Year Two & Beyond: A predictable, scalable digital growth engine and an operating model that sets the standard across the business.

## BENEFITS & CULTURE

Cosmos offers a positive, purpose-driven workplace guided by clear values, autonomy, and mutual support. Compensation and benefits package includes:

Paid vacation, sick leave, and Five Mission Days

401(k) company contribution

Professional development programs and continuous learning opportunities

## PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Work is performed in a collaborative office environment. Must be able to communicate clearly. Sit for extended periods of time, frequently reach with hands and arms, including overhead; occasionally stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Hearing abilities are required. Vision abilities required including close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

## EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Cosmos Corporation is an equal-opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. Cosmos Corporation makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

# Vice President, Performance Marketing

Life Surge Llc

[Florida](https://jooble.org/jobs/Florida)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-454809302748767896?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1252858155168222373&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Title : Vice President of Performance Marketing

Employment Type : Full-Time, 40 hours/week

Reports to : Chief Growth Officer

FLSA Status : Exempt

Position Type : In-Person

Who We Are

SurgeU is a mission-driven parent company overseeing a family of brands, including Life Surge, focused on faith-based business education and empowerment. One of the fastest-growing organizations in the country, Life Surge/SurgeU exists to inspire, train, and equip people to build their personal impact in ways that glorify God.By producing 30+ annual events and providing financial education to thousands around the nation, we do just that.

We are a team of experienced professionals who are passionate about helping people learn, grow, and connect so they may live more enriched lives. Our culture is one where we celebrate each other, individually and as a team. We look to acknowledge and reward our star performers. Let your light shine in our company!

The Vice President of Performance Marketing is a senior leader responsible for driving measurable growth through data driven acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies across paid channels, email marketing, and web operations. This role combines strategic vision with execution leadership to maximize ROI, improve customer engagement, and scale performance efforts that impact pipeline and revenue.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Planning

- Develop and lead a unified performance marketing strategy that aligns with business goals and drives outcomes across paid media, email, and web experience.
- Set performance KPIs and goals tied to acquisition, retention, revenue, and efficiency.

Paid Media & Acquisition

- Direct all paid acquisition channels, including search (SEM/SEO alignment), social ads, display, programmatic, video (YouTube, OTT/CTV), affiliates, and emerging performance channels.
- Implement testing frameworks for creative, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, and measurement.
- Evaluate emerging platforms and technologies; continuously refine channel mix for performance and efficiency.

Email Marketing & Lifecycle Engagement

- Oversee email strategy and execution. This includes nurture flows, segmentation, automation, personalization, and conversion driven campaigns.
- Collaborate with CRM, content, and product teams to grow subscriber value, improve engagement metrics, and reduce churn.

Web Operations (WebOps) & Conversion Optimization

- Lead WebOps to ensure seamless site performance, user experience, and conversion pathways.
- Partner with UX, development, and analytics teams tooptimizelanding pages, funnels, and conversion points that directlyimpactperformance KPIs.

Analytics, Attribution & Measurement

- Build dashboards and reporting frameworks that providereal-timeinsight into performance across channels (paid, email, web, organic).
- Own attribution modeling to understand channel contributions and inform budget decisions.

CrossFunctional Collaboration

- Work with Product, Brand, Creative, Organic Social, PR, Sales Ops, and other teams to align messaging, landing pages, and funnels with product roadmaps and overarching go to market strategies.
- Manage agency and vendor partnerships, ensuring accountability and enhancing performance capability and scale.

Performance & Optimization

- Drive continuous testing (creative, audience, placements, bids, landing pages) to improve ROAS, CPA, and profitability.
- Build and maintain dashboards and reporting systems for real-time insights.
- Ensure rigorous attribution and measurement frameworks (MMM, MTA,last-touch, etc.)
- Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and platform changes.
- Lead innovation initiatives including AI-driven optimization, advanced segmentation, and new adtech.
- Champion data integrity, tagging integrity, and rigorous testing across acquisition, email, and the website.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Digital Marketing, Business, Analytics, or relatedfield.
- 10+ years of experience owning performance across paid channels, email lifecycle strategies, and web operations with measurable impact on growth metrics.
- Proven success managing large, multi-million-dollar media budgets with strong ROI results.
- Deepexpertisein paid social, paid search, programmatic, and performance marketing ecosystems.
- Strong analytical background withproficiencyin attribution, marketing analytics tools, and A/B testing methodologies.
- Comfortable with analytics stacks (e.g., GA4, CRM tracking), automation platforms, and web performance tools.
- Experience working in high-growth environments with shifting priorities.
- Exceptional leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills to drive business outcomes.
- Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution as needed.
- Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Holiday, and Paid Time Off.
- Non-corporate, casual, entrepreneurial, comfortable, fun, and proactive work environment.
- High-level performers, disciplined, and self-motivated people will dovery wellin this environment.

Life Surge/SurgeU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and seek to empower each individual while supporting the many perspectives, skills, and experiences within our workforce. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

# Director, Performance and Growth Marketing

$180k - $250k

Full-time

Kiddom

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7722056557579884396?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=138&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-469571549066149087&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Kiddom**

Kiddom is transforming K–12 education by bringing high-quality curriculum, instructional tools, and student analytics together in one coherent system. We are building **Learning Intelligence Technology (LIT),** a new category that gives educators the infrastructure to plan, teach, assess, and respond to student needs. With Kiddom, educators spend less time managing administrative burden and more time delivering meaningful student instruction. Kiddom helps schools and districts deliver more equitable, effective, and adaptive learning experiences.

Kiddom is a K-12 curriculum and instructional platform company serving districts and schools. The Director leads demand generation and performance for the go-to-market team, owning campaign operations, paid media, lifecycle programs, the multi-touch attribution model, and funnel reporting from first touch to sales handoff. Works hands-on in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce Core, partnering with Revenue Operations to own system integrations and data infrastructure. Turns demand strategy into measured, optimized programs and recommends where to invest or pivot.

**Responsibilities**

- Owns the annual and quarterly demand gen plan by market, segment, and product, built with the VP of Marketing and Sales leadership. Owns the marketing-sourced pipeline forecast and runs campaigns, content calendars, launches, and metrics so every channel has a goal and a result.

- Owns performance for Google Ads, LinkedIn, social media campaigns, and Profound Ad Studio, including the annual paid media budget, budget pacing, audience strategy, and testing. Runs experiments on messaging, offers, and conversion, and optimizes against cost per lead and marketing-sourced pipeline.

- Administers Salesforce Marketing Cloud operations, including audience, segmentation, agentic scheduling, deliverability, sender reputation, and forms. Keeps district and school audiences accurate by state, role, and market.

- Designs the path from Salesforce campaign to Sales Account Executive notification. Owns the MQL definition, lead scoring, and handoff standards with Sales and Revenue Operations. Maintains campaign structure in Salesforce and accelerates routing and accuracy.

- Owns lifecycle and nurture programs across prospects and current customers. Sets audience rules, cadence, and suppression logic, and keeps acquisition and customer communications compliant.

- Reports the weekly and monthly lead, funnel, and pipeline metrics for Marketing leadership, Sales, and the executive team. Sets metric definitions with Revenue Operations and turns results into clear recommendations.

- Defines the attribution approach with the VP of Marketing and connects spend, content, and AI search visibility to traffic, leads, and pipeline.

- Develops targeting and measurement for account-based marketing and territory programs by market.

- Runs a regular operating cadence with Sales leadership, field teams, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. Shares campaign calendars and brings field feedback back into targeting and messaging.

- Writes clear requirements for integrations, automations, and data needs, and prioritizes with the VP of Marketing and Revenue Operations. Determines technology, integration requirements, and works with IT on access and security.


**Working relationships**

Reports to the VP of Marketing. Works daily with the Marketing Content Strategist, Product Marketing, Field and Events, and Brand. Partners regularly with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Revenue Operations, and IT. Manages external relationships with ad platforms, agencies, and data and marketing technology vendors.

**Skills and experience**

**Required**

- 8+ years in B2B demand generation, performance marketing, or marketing operations, including leading programs against pipeline or MQL targets in partnership with Sales leadership.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or an equivalent enterprise marketing automation platform, including audiences, segmentation, campaign hierarchies, reports, operations, and dashboards.

- Experience running paid media programs (search, paid social, or display) with budget ownership.

- Experience building lead flow and routing, and defining MQL and lead scoring with Sales and Revenue Operations.

- Experience with account-based or territory-based marketing.

- Strong analytical skills: builds funnel, conversion, and attribution reporting for executives.

- Daily, practical use of Claude or similar AI tools for analysis, scaling, integrations, and documentation.

- Sound judgment with incomplete information, and the ability to explain trade-offs to non-technical leaders.


**Preferred**

- GA4 experience, including attribution and reporting design.

- Familiarity with SEO and AEO, and how AI search visibility is measured.

- Experience with low-code tools or AI agents for workflow automation and marketing tools such as Qualified PiperX (AI SDR).

- Familiarity with K-12 education, district buying cycles, and curriculum adoption, or other long-cycle, complex B2B sales.


**What success looks like**

- Every active campaign has a documented owner, audience, goal, and live reporting

- Lower cost per qualified lead and stronger marketing-sourced pipeline

- Leads route to the right seller quickly and accurately, with Sales confident in Marketing leads.

- One trusted funnel and pipeline view used by Marketing, Sales, and the executive team on a regular cadence.

- Marketing Cloud integration and optimization.

- A Marketing team that uses Claude as the default way of working, with fewer manual steps in campaign and reporting workflows.


**What we offer**

- Full time permanent employees are eligible for the following benefits from their first day of employment:

- Competitive salary

- Meaningful equity

- Health insurance benefits: medical (various PPO/HMO/HSA plans), dental, vision, disability and life insurance

- 401k plan

- One Medical membership _(in participating locations)_

- Flexible vacation time policy (subject to internal approval). _Average use 4 weeks off per year._

- 10 paid sick days per year _(pro rated depending on start date)_

- Paid holidays

- Paid bereavement leave

- Paid family leave after birth/adoption. Minimum of 16 paid weeks for birthing parents, 10 weeks for caretaker parents. _Meant to supplement benefits offered by State._

- Commuter and FSA plans

# Director of Performance Marketing

Relay

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/962003527047060486?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3813844418699744312&crId=US_0US_0)

Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Relay's performance marketing team runs one of the most analytically sophisticated paid programs in the SMB fintech space — operating across paid search, paid social, affiliate, CTV, and direct mail with a $2-3M monthly budget. Your mission: make every dollar work harder, build the measurement infrastructure to prove it, and grow a team that can execute at the pace Relay moves.

### What You'll Be Doing

- **Own Relay's full paid media portfolio** — paid search, paid social, affiliate, CTV, linear TV, and direct mail. Set channel strategy, budget allocation, and performance targets across brand and performance objectives. Hold the team accountable to both.

- **Directly manage and develop a team of performance marketers** , owning hiring, leveling, performance management, and growth pathways while coaching on channel mechanics, creative strategy, and business impact.

- **Lead Relay's TV and CTV strategy** , partnering with Brand and Creative on messaging and measurement. Build the attribution infrastructure that connects upper-funnel investment to downstream efficiency.

- **Drive paid search and paid social programs** with a bias toward continuous experimentation — audience segmentation, creative testing, bidding strategy, and landing page optimization across both PLG and sales-assisted conversion paths.

- **Own the affiliate program end-to-end** , including partner recruitment, commission structure, compliance, and performance management. Identify non-obvious distribution partners in the SMB ecosystem.

- **Work with the data team to build and maintain Relay's measurement infrastructure** across paid channels — media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, and incrementality testing. Own the methodology and use it to strengthen decision making.

- **Own paid media budget modeling, pacing, and forecasting** , partnering with Finance on plans that hold up under scrutiny and flex intelligently as performance data comes in.


### Who You Are

- **8+ years in performance marketing or paid media** , with at least 2 years managing a team, ideally at a high-growth SaaS, fintech, or subscription business.

- **You've owned a multi-million dollar monthly paid media budget** and can walk through how you've allocated across channels, how your thinking evolved, and what you'd do differently.

- **You are an expert in attribution** — you can walk through an incrementality test you've designed, a media mix model you've commissioned, or an attribution debate you've settled. You don't accept last-click as an answer.

- **Deep hands-on fluency in at least two of:** paid search, paid social, CTV/programmatic, or affiliate — with working knowledge across the rest.

- **You've driven acquisition into both PLG and sales-assisted funnels** and understand how channel mix, creative, and landing experience need to flex depending on which motion you're feeding.

- **Strong communicator who can translate channel data into business narrative** — you've made a budget ask to a CFO or CEO that landed.

- **SQL and AI-fluent** in how you and your team work — using it to accelerate analysis, creative iteration, reporting and audience research.


### Bonus Points

- Experience in a regulated industry (fintech, healthcare, insurance) — you know how to run aggressive acquisition programs within compliance constraints

- Experience marketing to small business owners or self-employed professionals

- Experience with direct mail as an acquisition channel

- A public POV on performance marketing, attribution, or media strategy


### The Interview Process

- **Stage 1:** 45-minute video call with a member of the Talent team

- **Stage 2:** 60-minute video call with the VP of Marketing

- **Stage 3:** 60-minute Live Scenario with the Marketing team

- **Stage 4:** Values interview with a member of the Leadership team


### Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $243,000 USD to $297,000 USD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $270,000 USD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

### Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

- **You push relentlessly for reinvention:** You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

- **You crave autonomy:** We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’s someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

- **You own your work:** You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

- **You build with AI, not just use it:** You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

- **You care about impact, not noise:** You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself.

- **You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity:** You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

- **You seek out feedback:** You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

- **Small businesses are why we’re here:** Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.


### Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Important Notice: Relay’s recruitment team only contacts candidates and corresponds from official corporate email addresses ending in @relayfi.com. **About Honeydew**

No one should suffer from a treatable skin disease because they couldn't access care. That's what Honeydew is fixing - a platform connecting hundreds of millions of people to licensed dermatologists, FDA-approved treatments, and ongoing skin health support. We've helped 50,000+ patients get life-changing results, we're growing 4x YoY, and we're just getting started.

**The Opportunity**

Honeydew is growing rapidly, and paid media is a core part of our growth engine. Meta, Google, TikTok, a growing roster of creator and influencer partners, and an in-house creative team are all part of an high-performance operation.

We're hiring a **Director of Performance Marketing** to own this engine end to end. You'll manage an eight-figure budget, and you'll have real autonomy to put it wherever the returns are greatest. You'll report to and work directly with the Head of Growth, as well as CEO and CFO on strategy and targets.

A lot is already built around you. An in-house creative team (strategy, production, editing) that briefs, makes, and iterates on the assets you'll need. A partnerships leader who runs celebrity, creator, and influencer relationships and keeps talent and content flowing. A paid search lead and paid social coordinator who will report to you. Your job is to increase our rate of growth by deciding where dollars go, what gets tested, and where the results take us next.

One thing to know going in: we advertise prescription treatments. Every paid platform has health restrictions, and tracking is HIPAA-adjacent. If you've bought in a regulated category, that's a real advantage. If you haven't, you'll need to find the constraint interesting rather than annoying.

**What you'll own**

- **Spend allocation & buying.** You'll be accountable for paid social & search spend and strategy on day one, and you've personally run meaningful budgets on several platforms. You have an excellent understanding of what the platform automations and when to override them
- **Measurement.** ROAS and CAC by channel, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, incrementality and geo holdout tests, and the responsibility to know when each one is lying.
- **CRO and Digital Product.** You'll work with our designers and engineers to customize sleek onboarding experiences for the different channels your audiences reach.
- **New channels.** Testing and launching platforms we're not on yet, and buying on them yourself before we hire for them.
- **The creative testing loop.** What gets tested, when and how, and what the results tell the creative team to make next.
- **The team.** You'll manage our paid search lead and paid media coordinator and be responsible for their development. Both are high performing and ready for more scope.
- **Data, tracking, and privacy.** Our marketing data pipelines, conversion tracking, and privacy and consent platform, so the numbers hold up and we stay compliant.
- **Paid media strategy.** Budget planning, forecasting, channel mix, and the case for what we should and shouldn't be doing.

You'll be measured on blended CAC at target new patient volume.

**Throughout 2027, your work will include:**

- Launching new channels: connected TV, a bigger TikTok presence, affiliate, programmatic, and in-app inventory
- Rebuilding spend allocation around incrementality rather than platform-reported ROAS
- Leveling up tracking and measurement so it survives consent changes and finance trusts it
- Partnering closely with the creative team on testing
- Hiring and leveling up the team to match the channel mix

**Who we're looking for**

You're probably 7 to 10 years in. You've led performance marketing at a fast-growing D2C company (Series B to D is the sweet spot), or you've done it for several at an agency and want to own one business in-house. You've bought across the major performance channels: social, search, CTV, programmatic, display. You're extremely analytical and you understand the whole funnel, from first impression to a patient starting treatment, and you make spend decisions with all of it in view. You can explain a complicated call to a founder or a CFO in plain language.

Nice to haves: healthcare, telehealth, or subscription experience; CTV, programmatic, or affiliate buying; server-side tracking and consent management setup.

**This probably isn't the role for you if:**

- You want to set strategy and have someone else run the accounts
- You've only ever bought on one platform
- You need a mature data team to get an answer

**Compensation & Benefits**

- Salary: $170,000-$200,000 based on experience
- Equity in Honeydew
- Flexible PTO
- Free Honeydew membership
- Health, vision, and dental insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- One Medical, Kindbody, Talkspace, and HealthAdvocate memberships
- Company MacBook + monthly internet stipend

Inspira Education

##### Director of Performance Marketing

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Director of Performance Marketing will architect and lead our cutting-edge performance marketing strategies. In this high-impact position, you'll have the unique opportunity to drive how people discover and engage with our ed-tech services. Your actions will be tied directly to client acquisition and revenue goals, constantly testing new platforms and approaches to stay ahead of the latest trends in the rapidly evolving digital landscape. You will be tasked with building a high-velocity, data-driven growth engine to acquire, activate, and engage clients. You will own our consumer client acquisition strategy, driving growth through high-performance paid media, including experimentation, conversion rate optimization, and innovative acquisition strategies.

Working closely with the founders and leveraging a meaningful budget, you'll craft comprehensive go-to-market strategies that drive client acquisition and serve as a trusted thought partner to leaders across sales and customer success. Your strategic insights will directly influence company-wide decisions and contribute to Inspira's mission of improving education accessibility.

This role demands analytical rigor, operational excellence, and strategic leadership. Your expertise in paid media execution and website management will be instrumental in building a world-class performance marketing operation.

This is an in-person role requiring 5 day/week in our NYC office (Gramercy).

Set and drive the direct-to-consumer growth strategy across various channels: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok Ads, etc. – with the ability to be hands-on when needed

Relentlessly test to identify new growth channels

Drive performance and continuously optimize campaigns, audiences, and creative strategy to maximize ROAS across the performance marketing ecosystem.

Lead A/B testing, cohort analysis, and customer segmentation strategies to improve campaign performance.

Leverage SQL and Python for deep analytics, predictive modeling, and customer insights

Develop forecasting models and own performance reporting across all marketing funnels

Collaborate with a data team to develop and implement attribution models to evaluate the effectiveness of different channels

Collaborate with other marketing channel leads to ensure that consumer behavior trends are leveraged in other marketing channels

Develop a data-driven plan, setting and reporting on full-funnel KPIs to support business goals and priorities

Analyze key metrics to understand the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, make data-driven decisions to optimize performance and budget allocation, and report on performance to stakeholders

Establish yourself as a thought leader in marketing analytics and attribution, driving data-driven decision-making across the organization

Lead our CRO initiatives and optimize client touchpoints to increase ROI

Develop strong relationships with product, customer experience, tech, and sales leaders

Champion a work environment where your team feels comfortable taking calculated risks, continuously experimenting, iterating, and executing with urgency

Be an important voice for the Marketing team and partner to the founders, understanding how to hit revenue goals while staying true to the brand and putting the customer first

Make strong, principled decisions and influence a broad cross-functional group to execute

Benchmark against competitors and industry best practices to maintain a leadership position in digital performance marketing

Manage junior team members, ensuring technology and campaign execution meet business goals

Proven experience (typically 6+ years) in performance marketing roles, with a strong track record of driving measurable results

Mastery of paid search and paid social, and a deep understanding of other digital marketing channels and their respective best practices

Hands-on experience with key advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.)

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions based on CAC and ROAS goals

Familiar with Marketing Automation and Attribution tools

Knowledge of advanced data analysis tools/languages such as SQL and Python

Strong comfort level working with data and proficiency in web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) with the ability to extract, interpret, and leverage data for decision-making

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making

Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely

Experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems

A passion for cultivating authentic connections

Individuals who embody a winning attitude

A mindset fueled by curiosity

Determination to hustle and overcome challenges

An infectious enthusiasm and adaptability

Boundless energy and relentless tenacity

Amazing people with a great vision and values

Mission-driven team culture focused on student success

Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

# VP - Product Marketing

Skanai

[Menlo Park, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Menlo-Park%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-940319092095917069?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7496&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4873008454307556604&crId=US_0US_0)

**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Join our diverse, collaborative team of 200+ innovators solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Here, diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and your contributions will directly transform how Fortune 500 companies operate. This is your opportunity to shape the future of work itself alongside talented colleagues who challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

### **About the Role**

We're seeking an experienced VP, Product Marketing to lead our product marketing function and drive Skan AI's market positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy. You'll be responsible for establishing Skan AI as a category leader, building comprehensive product marketing infrastructure, and ensuring our value proposition resonates across every customer segment and use case. This role requires category creation expertise, deep technical fluency in enterprise AI and automation markets, and a proven ability to execute at the pace of a fast-moving AI company scaling into its next phase of growth.

Ideal candidates have 12+ years of product marketing experience, including at least 5 years in leadership roles, with proven success in positioning, messaging, analyst relations, and go-to-market execution for enterprise technology companies. You'll work cross-functionally with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to own Skan AI's market position and drive product marketing excellence.

### **Responsibilities**

- **Strategic Positioning & Messaging**
 - Define and own Skan AI's positioning, messaging architecture, and value propositions across all products and solutions
 - Develop compelling narratives that differentiate Skan AI's approach and resonate with target buyers
 - Craft executive messaging for board presentations, conference keynotes, investor communications, and customer engagements
 - Drive competitive strategy and maintain competitive intelligence across the market landscape
- **Product Marketing Foundation**
 - Build and maintain core product marketing assets including persona templates, value propositions, messaging hierarchies, use case libraries, battle cards, and ROI frameworks
 - Develop comprehensive sales enablement including pitch decks, demo scripts, objection handling, discovery frameworks, and sales plays
 - Collaborate with content marketing to create high-impact assets: whitepapers, solution briefs, data sheets, demo videos, webinars, and customer stories
- **Analyst & Industry Relations**
 - Own analyst strategy and all interactions with key industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Everest Group, IDC)
 - Lead analyst evaluation processes including positioning strategy, customer reference coordination, and briefing preparation
 - Translate analyst insights into actionable sales and marketing assets that strengthen market credibility
- **Go-to-Market Execution**
 - Own end-to-end product launch strategy and execution for new products and capabilities
 - Develop industry-specific positioning that translates platform capabilities into vertical value propositions
 - Partner with Product and Revenue teams on pricing strategy, packaging evolution, and market expansion
 - Build customer marketing programs including reference development, case studies, and advocacy cultivation
 - Translate product roadmap into sales-ready positioning and enablement, and partner directly with sales enablement to keep training current and build real excitement in the field
 - Work directly with customers to surface real, marketable use cases, and own the feedback loop back to product so what customers actually need shapes what gets built next.
- Lead market research to validate opportunities, understand buyer personas, and inform product strategy
- Establish systematic voice-of-customer programs through interviews, win/loss analysis, and customer feedback loops
- Maintain competitive intelligence on market trends, competitor moves, messaging, and positioning
- Synthesize insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market priorities
- **Cross-Functional Leadership & Team Building**
 - Present regularly to executive leadership and the board on product marketing strategy, market dynamics, and business outcomes
 - Partner with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and execution excellence
 - Build and scale the product marketing function through hiring, development, and process optimization
 - Foster a culture of customer obsession, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision making
- **Qualifications & Skills**
 - 12+ years of product marketing experience in enterprise AI or complex enterprise technology platforms, including at least 5 years in leadership roles
 - Proven track record in positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution for enterprise technology companies
 - Deep expertise in enterprise sales cycles with Global 2000 companies
 - Demonstrated success in analyst relations, with measurable improvements in positioning and market perception
 - Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand complex enterprise technology and translate it into business value
 - Expert-level proficiency developing go-to-market strategies, positioning frameworks, and messaging architectures
 - Outstanding executive communication skills, with experience presenting to C-suite, boards, and large audiences
 - Exceptional writing ability across strategic documents, sales enablement, web copy, and thought leadership
 - Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams
 - Equally comfortable leading a board presentation and rewriting a sales deck at 9pm before a big demo
 - BA/BS degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred
- **Nice to Have**
 - Experience specifically in agentic AI or automation platform markets
 - Background in product marketing during high-growth or market inflection phases
 - Established relationships with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Everest, HFS, etc.)
 - Speaking experience at major industry conferences
 - Experience with pricing and packaging strategy
 - Track record of successful category positioning or market leadership initiatives

**The US base salary range for this full-time position is $220,000-$240,000, plus an annual performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and work location.**

Financialnarrative

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4791239275655642270?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1743887311897795633&crId=US_0US_0)

### Head of Brand and Performance Marketing, EquityZen - Executive Director

EquityZen is looking for a Head of Brand and Digital Marketing for Morgan Stanley Private Markets to join our growing team.

### Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead the development of the brand strategy and marketing programs aimed at customer acquisition and engagement across the Morgan Stanley ecosystem (Morgan Stanley at Work, ETRADE, and Financial Advisors). This role requires deep proficiency in both brand strategy/activation and marketing execution, including developing and optimizing programs across the customer lifecycle at a one-to-many scale. Your primary goal is to ensure brand differentiation, cohesion and drive performance reporting tied to program, campaign, and business goals.

This role requires deep proficiency in both brand strategy and brand marketing as well as performance marketing. To deliver on goals, this candidate would work in partnership with Morgan Stanley Wealth Management Centers of Excellence in Brand, Media, SEO, etc. to bring plans to life.

Core to this role is deep experience with paid media partners and tools including Google Ads and Google Analytics as well as work experience with other paid channels across direct, paid search and social (Bing, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn). The ideal candidate would also have experience with lifecycle marketing automation tools (best case would be experience using Hubspot) and have experience building performance and tracking reporting – including making recommendations based on data – and using tracking / reporting tools (e.g. Tableau).

### WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Define opportunity for Morgan Stanley Private Markets and develop and execute on the brand and performance marketing plan that ties to business and marketing goals. Define positioning, value propositions, core messaging and roles of brands across audiences and build programs to deliver on the plan.
- Build, monitor, and optimize paid media programs across channels including Google Ads and paid social (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) with a focus on both acquisition and ongoing engagement.
- Plan and execute automated lifecycle marketing campaigns via marketing automation tools (e.g.,Hubspot) to nurture long-term, ongoing relationships with investors and shareholders.
- Oversee marketing reporting, set KPIs and budget, and use data (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau) to track performance, generate insights, and improve our unit economics and client experience.
- Conduct A/B and multivariate experiments, including channel and landing page tests.
- Partner with other private market marketing team members to deliver on SEO, paid media, and content approaches.
- Work with internal Compliance function to ensure a compliant marketing operation.

### THE RIGHT STUFF

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or relatedfield
- 15+ years’ experience working in digital marketing, including expertise in performance, growth and lifecycle marketing; affiliate marketing experience a plus
- Strategic mindset; able to distill opportunities to their essence and devise plans to meet those strategies
- Responsible for development and execution of key projects, building annual plans for areas of responsibility. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively and influence through expertise is highly valued. Experience leading marketing programs for financial services, fintechs or brands targeting affluent consumers would make an excellent fit for this role. Experience working in regulated industries is also a plus.
- Data-driven mentality with the ability to analyze and report data across various mediums and tools including Google Analytics,Hubspot, Excel / Google Sheets,Mixpanelor similar product analytics tools, Impact or similar affiliate marketing tracking tools
- Demonstrated ability to craft and manage marketing budgets
- Proven success executing strategic marketing campaigns aimed at both customer acquisition and engagement and across various digital channels
- Deep knowledge of financial services and B2C marketing with some familiarity with B2B
- Proven success as a manager to develop and guide performance of a talented team

### Benefits & Compensation

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $150,000 and $250,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

# Senior Director, Paid Media Performance

$140k - $175k

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/345090426517243895?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=162&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2981753433479117486&crId=US_0US_0)

**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

## Overview:

As the Senior Director, Paid Media Performance, you will develop strategic recommendations and own performance for paid user acquisition of paid media across search, social and programmatic channels, as well as programmatic/DSP investment for the full Paramount+ title portfolio. You will help shape the vision, in partnership with senior leadership, for how paid media drives efficient, scalable subscriber and engagement growth. Directing multiple large campaigns across genres and translating business goals into channel strategy, audience approach, and measurable performance targets.

You will lead and develop a team of paid media specialists across search, social and programmatic disciplines, while also managing media partner relationships and multi-million dollar media budgets across channels.

This is a senior leadership role accountable for results across multiple campaigns, channels, and disciplines. Requiring solid people leadership, sound judgment on decisions that carry real business risk, and the ability to drive priorities and influence direction across the organization.

This is an on-site position, based at our New York City office.

## Responsibilities include but not limited to:

- Develop and execute the paid media acquisition strategy across paid search, social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic/DSP channels (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, Samsung DSP), aligning channel and audience approach to the business goals across all genres.

- Own CPA and efficiency targets across the portfolio and across channels (e.g., sports, drama, reality, and service titles), continually optimizing tactics, media mix, and audience targeting to scale acquisition cost-effectively.

- Lead development of audience targeting and consolidation strategy across search, social and programmatic, including genre-level segmentation and cross-platform/cross-channel audience consolidation, to improve scale and efficiency.

- Lead activation of incrementality and platform/channel performance testing in partnership with internal testing teams.

- Provide feasibility guidance on the testing roadmap across social and programmatic, turning learnings into action.

- Own media recommendations and launch support for key title releases and seasonal tentpoles across channels, ensuring the full paid media mix is positioned to deliver against goals.

- Lead, coach, and develop the paid media team across social and programmatic disciplines, setting priorities, standards, and clear expectations to build a robust, high-performing function.

- Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing teams and senior leadership on budget, reporting, and strategic decisions, and represent paid search, social and programmatic in broader team planning.


## Basic Qualifications:

- 12+ years of experience in paid media/digital performance marketing across paid search, social and programmatic channels, with 5+ years of people management experience leading teams.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.


## Additional Qualifications:

- Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and drive priorities for multiple large paid media programs across paid search, social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic DSPs (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, TTD), with deep, hands-on channel expertise.

- Hands-on experience planning, executing, and optimizing programmatic campaigns within at least one major DSP. Experience with audience and inventory targeting, bid strategy, and PMPs/private marketplace deals.

- Deep track record owning CPA and efficiency targets and managing large media budgets across channels and formats to performance goals.

- Experience developing audience strategy, testing for incrementality, and platform/channel testing, and using measurement to inform decisions.

- Exemplary cross-functional leadership and communication skills. With experience partnering with marketing, strategy, and senior stakeholders.

- Sound judgment on decisions that carry business risk, and the ability to recommend resourcing and staffing to meet objectives.

- Solid data and analytics fluency, including comfort with platform/DSP reporting, BI tools, and experimentation or measurement frameworks to turn performance data into decisions.

- Hands-on platform experience across social and/or programmatic and a working command of the day-to-day execution the team performs, while now leading strategy rather than executing in-platform.

- Experience in entertainment, streaming, or media/subscription businesses.

- Experience with social ad management/ad-serving platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Smartly, CM360) and/or programmatic DSPs beyond DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, and Samsung DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, StackAdapt).

- Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana).

- Relevant platform or DSP certifications (e.g., Meta Blueprint, DV360 Certification) or equivalent.


**About Skydance** Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Director of Growth Marketing

Marketing • Hireology • Chicago, IL • Hybrid • Full-Time

About Hireology

Hireology is a 15-year market leader in HR technology, trusted by thousands of businesses to help them hire and build outstanding teams. Recognized by Built In Chicago as a Best Place to Work multiple years running, we’re a hybrid team of committed and optimistic talent looking for the next person to help us build the future of hiring for frontline, high-volume businesses.

About the Role

As Director of Growth Marketing, you will own the strategy and team responsible for generating marketing-sourced pipeline, both new logo and expansion. You will lead a team of channel owners covering demand generation, customer marketing, partner marketing, and events, plus the agencies and vendors supporting them.

Working closely with Sales and Customer Success, you will create demand, engage priority accounts, drive adoption and expansion in the existing customer base, and improve conversion from initial interest through closed revenue. Success will be measured primarily by marketing-sourced pipeline, new logo and expansion, supported by channel efficiency, conversion, velocity, and customer acquisition cost.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Strategy & Investment

- Translate Hireology’s growth goals into an integrated strategy for generating pipeline across new customer acquisition and expansion.
- Own the annual and quarterly marketing-sourced pipeline target, forecast performance, identify gaps, and lead recovery plans when performance is behind plan.
- Decide which channels and programs deserve investment, and reallocate as performance dictates.
- Balance near-term demand capture with programs that build awareness and preference before buyers enter an active buying cycle.
- Own the growth marketing budget and defend investment decisions with pipeline contribution, conversion, and return.
- Ground programs in customer insight, market dynamics, performance data, and a real understanding of how frontline businesses research and buy technology.

Account-Based Marketing

- Lead ABM programs targeting named accounts across priority verticals.
- Partner with Sales on account selection, prioritization, messaging, and coordinated outreach.
- Use account, intent, buyer journey, and sales data to focus resources on the accounts most likely to move.
- Build the operating rhythm with Sales that keeps account strategy and marketing execution connected.

Customer Growth & Retention

- Oversee the marketing programs that improve customer outcomes, including adoption, retention, advocacy, and expansion revenue.
- Partner with Customer Success to turn product usage signals and feature launches into expansion pipeline.
- Develop a customer advocacy and reference program that supports both expansion and new business.
- Keep messaging consistent across the full customer journey, from first touch through renewal.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Build strong working relationships with Sales and Customer Success leadership, anchored in shared pipeline and retention goals.
- Partner with Revenue Operations on attribution, funnel definitions, handoffs, lead scoring, routing, and reporting.
- Partner with Product Marketing on audience insights, positioning, messaging, and campaign development.

Measurement and Operations

- Track marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue across source, influence, conversion, and velocity.
- Track marketing’s contribution to customer outcomes, including product adoption, retention, net revenue retention, and expansion revenue.
- Set program and channel KPIs that connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
- Partner with Revenue Operations and Customer Success on the data and reporting required to measure customer health, adoption, and expansion.
- Use performance data and experimentation to improve results and guide investment.
- Identify gaps in the funnel and lead cross-functional efforts to address them.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Hire, manage, and develop a multidisciplinary growth marketing team.
- Set clear goals, priorities, and accountability for direct reports.
- Develop team members into strategic owners of their channels and programs.
- Build the processes and operating rhythms required for effective execution.
- Represent Growth Marketing in company planning, budget development, and quarterly OKRs.

Qualifications

- 8 or more years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or integrated marketing within B2B SaaS.
- Experience owning pipeline strategy, budget, and performance for a sales-led mid-market motion.
- Demonstrated success generating qualified opportunities and pipeline.
- Experience leading integrated programs through internal teams, agencies, and cross-functional partners.
- Proven experience building ABM programs in partnership with Sales.
- Strong track record working with Sales leadership on pipeline planning, funnel performance, and account strategy.
- Experience managing and developing marketers across multiple disciplines.
- Strong command of marketing performance, funnel metrics, and investment decisions.
- Fluency with marketing automation, CRM, attribution, and ABM or intent platforms. Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and 6sense is helpful.
- Experience adapting marketing strategies across multiple verticals, industries, or buyer segments.
- Comfortable operating as both a strategist and hands-on leader.

Benefits

- Unlimited paid time off and mental health days
- Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage from day one
- 401(k) with company match
- Award-winning culture
- Hybrid office downtown Chicago
- External learning budget
- Amazing growth opportunities
